guide.summary: Words like 见面, 睡觉, 结婚 and 帮忙 look like one verb but are really verb + object (见 'see' + 面 'face'). The object slot is already full, so no second object can follow, and everything that normally sits between a verb and its object (了, 过, a duration, a count, 完, 的-phrases) goes in the middle of the word. Treat 睡觉 like 吃饭 and the rules fall out.

subs.label: No object after it: 跟他见面
subs.focus: The learner must decide where the other person or place goes: never after the word (见面他, 结婚她, 毕业大学, 出差上海) but before the verb (跟他见面, 向她道歉, 大学毕业, 去上海出差). Classic mistake: copying English 'meet him', 'marry her'. Never treat 担心 + object as wrong: 担心他 is correct.

subs.label: Person inside with 的: 帮他的忙, 生我的气
subs.focus: With 帮忙 and 生气 the person affected goes inside as 'person + 的': 帮我的忙, 生他的气. The learner must reject 帮忙我 and 生气我. Accept the alternatives 帮我 (plain 帮 takes an object), 给他帮忙 and 跟他生气, so never offer two of these as competing options in one item.

subs.label: 了 / 过 / 着 inside: 见过面
subs.focus: 过 and 着 attach to the verb half, not to the whole word: 见过面, 结过婚, 请过假, 说着话. Verb 了 also goes inside when the sentence continues or something is counted (吃了饭就走). 见面过 / 结婚过 are non-standard but heard: traps, never judge-wrong. Sentence-final 了 after the whole word (他结婚了, 我们放假了) is correct.

subs.label: Duration inside: 睡了八个小时觉
subs.focus: How long the action lasted goes between the two halves, after 了: 睡了八个小时(的)觉, 请了三天假, or the verb is repeated: 睡觉睡了八个小时. Classic mistake: 睡觉了八个小时, 游泳了一个小时. Also test the opposite case: point-like words (结婚, 毕业, 离婚) put the time since after the whole word: 结婚十年了 (结婚了十年了 is also natural).

subs.label: 次 / 个 inside: 见过一次面, 洗个澡
subs.focus: Number of times and the casual 个 go inside: 见过两次面, 结过两次婚, 洗了一个澡, 开了三个会, 帮我一个忙. The learner must place 次/个 between the halves. Classic mistake: 见面过两次, 洗澡了一个, 结婚过两次.

subs.label: Double only the verb: 散散步
subs.focus: For 'do a bit of' only the first half doubles: 散散步, 聊聊天, 帮帮忙, 见见面, 洗洗澡. Whole-word doubling (散步散步, 聊天聊天), by analogy with 休息休息, is said colloquially: key AAB, but never use ABAB as a judge-wrong sentence. Clear error: 散步一散步. Items may contrast a separable verb with a normal one.

subs.label: 得 needs the verb again: 唱歌唱得很好
subs.focus: 得 must touch a verb, so the verb is repeated after the object (唱歌唱得很好, 游泳游得很快) or the object is said first and the verb once (歌唱得很好). Classic mistake: 唱歌得很好, 跳舞得很漂亮, 睡觉得很晚.

subs.label: 完 / 好 / 不着 / 什么 inside: 吃完饭
subs.focus: Result words, potential forms and 什么 also go between the halves: 吃完饭, 上完课, 洗完澡, 没睡好觉, 睡不着觉, 生什么气. Classic mistake: 吃饭完, 上课完, 洗澡完, 睡觉不着, 生气什么.

rules.rule: The word already contains its object, so the other person cannot follow it. Bring the person in before the verb with 跟 or 和.
rules.pattern: Subject + 跟 / 和 + person + verb-object

examples.py: wǒ míng tiān gēn péng you jiàn miàn
examples.en: I'm meeting a friend tomorrow.

examples.zh: 他去年和女朋友结婚了。
examples.py: tā qù nián hé nǚ péng you jié hūn le
examples.en: He married his girlfriend last year.

examples.py: wǒ xǐ huan gēn tóng xué liáo tiān
examples.en: I like chatting with my classmates.

examples.py: nǐ wèi shén me gēn dì di dǎ jià
examples.en: Why did you fight with your little brother?

rules.note: 跟 and 和 are interchangeable here. This covers 见面, 结婚, 离婚, 聊天, 握手, 打架, 说话, 跳舞, 吃饭, 散步.

rules.rule: Some of these words pick a different word before the verb: 向 or 跟 for apologising, 给 for helping or applauding, 去 + place for a business trip, and the school simply goes in front of 毕业.
rules.pattern: Subject + 向 / 给 / 去 / 从 + person or place + verb-object

examples.py: nǐ yīng gāi xiàng tā dào qiàn
examples.en: You should apologise to her.

examples.zh: 爸爸下个星期去上海出差。
examples.py: bà ba xià gè xīng qī qù shàng hǎi chū chāi
examples.en: Dad is going to Shanghai on business next week.

examples.zh: 我哥哥去年大学毕业了。
examples.py: wǒ gē ge qù nián dà xué bì yè le
examples.en: My older brother graduated from university last year.

examples.py: dà jiā dōu gěi tā gǔ zhǎng
examples.en: Everyone applauded him.

rules.note: 担心 is the exception in this family: it freely takes an object (别担心我, 我很担心他的身体). Written Chinese also has 毕业于 + school, but 毕业大学 is wrong.

rules.rule: With 帮忙 and 生气 the person goes inside the word as 'person + 的'. Plain 帮 can take the person directly, but 帮忙 cannot.
rules.pattern: Subject + 帮 / 生 + person + 的 + 忙 / 气

examples.py: xiè xie nǐ bāng le wǒ de máng
examples.en: Thank you for helping me out.

examples.py: mā ma hái zài shēng wǒ de qì
examples.en: Mum is still angry with me.

examples.py: nǐ bié shēng tā de qì le
examples.en: Stop being angry with him.

examples.py: zhōu mò wǒ qù gěi péng you bāng máng
examples.en: I'm going to help a friend out this weekend.

rules.note: Also correct: 你能帮我吗 (帮 alone), 给他帮忙, 跟他生气. Only 帮忙我 and 生气我 are wrong.

rules.rule: 过 and 着 go right after the verb half. Verb 了 goes there too when the sentence carries on or a number follows. Negative: 没 + verb + 过 + object.
rules.pattern: Subject + verb + 了 / 过 / 着 + object

examples.py: wǒ men yǐ qián jiàn guo miàn
examples.en: We have met before.

examples.py: tā cóng lái méi qǐng guo jià
examples.en: He has never taken leave.

examples.py: wǒ chī le fàn jiù qù zhǎo nǐ
examples.en: I'll come and find you as soon as I've eaten.

examples.zh: 他们正说着话，老师进来了。
examples.py: tā men zhèng shuō zhe huà lǎo shī jìn lái le
examples.en: They were talking when the teacher came in.

rules.note: 了 at the very end of the sentence after the whole word is normal and correct: 他结婚了, 我们放假了, 她生气了. You may hear 见面过 in casual speech, but the standard form is 见过面.

rules.rule: How long an activity lasted goes between the two halves, after 了; 的 before the object is optional. Or say the whole word, then repeat the verb with the duration.
rules.pattern: Subject + verb + 了 + duration + (的) + object

examples.zh: 我昨天睡了八个小时觉。
examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí jiào
examples.en: I slept for eight hours yesterday.

examples.zh: 我们聊了一个下午的天。
examples.py: wǒ men liáo le yī gè xià wǔ de tiān
examples.en: We chatted for a whole afternoon.

examples.py: tā shàng gè yuè qǐng le sān tiān jià
examples.en: He took three days off last month.

examples.py: tā yóu yǒng yóu le bàn gè xiǎo shí
examples.en: She swam for half an hour.

rules.note: The standard forms do not put 了 + duration after the unsplit word: 睡了八个小时觉, not 睡觉了八个小时 (which some speakers say casually).

rules.rule: 结婚, 毕业 and 离婚 happen at a point and do not last. To say how long it has been since, put the time after the whole word and end with 了.

examples.py: tā men jié hūn shí nián le
examples.en: They have been married for ten years.

examples.py: wǒ dà xué bì yè liǎng nián le
examples.en: It's been two years since I graduated from university.

examples.py: tā men lí hūn yǐ jīng sān nián le
examples.en: They have been divorced for three years already.

rules.note: 放假 can go either way with a different meaning: 我们放了三天假 (the holiday lasted three days), 我们放假三天了 (we have been on holiday for three days now).

rules.rule: The number of times (次) and the casual 个 go inside, after 了 or 过 if there is one.
rules.pattern: Subject + verb + (了 / 过) + number + 次 / 个 + object

examples.py: wǒ men zhǐ jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn
examples.en: We have only met twice.

examples.py: tā jié guo liǎng cì hūn
examples.en: He has been married twice.

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng xiān xǐ gè zǎo
examples.en: I'd like to take a shower first.

examples.py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ yī gè máng ma
examples.en: Can you do me a favour?

rules.note: 个 here does not really count; it makes the action sound light and casual (洗个澡, 睡个觉, 理个发, 开个会).

rules.rule: To say 'do a bit of it', double only the verb half. Ordinary two-syllable verbs double as a whole (休息休息); for separable ones the standard form is AAB.

examples.zh: 吃完饭我们出去散散步吧。
examples.py: chī wán fàn wǒ men chū qù sàn sàn bù ba
examples.en: Let's go out for a little walk after dinner.

examples.py: yǒu kòng lái wǒ jiā liáo liáo tiān
examples.en: Come over for a chat when you're free.

examples.py: qǐng nǐ bāng bāng máng
examples.en: Please lend a hand.

examples.zh: 周末我喜欢在家唱唱歌。
examples.py: zhōu mò wǒ xǐ huan zài jiā chàng chàng gē
examples.en: At weekends I like to sing a bit at home.

rules.note: Only casual, deliberate activities double; 结婚, 毕业, 离婚, 生气 and 出差 do not. Finished action: 了 between the two verbs (我们昨天聊了聊天). Whole-word 散步散步 is heard in casual speech; AAB is the form to produce.

rules.rule: 得 must come straight after a verb, never after the object half. Say the whole word, then repeat the verb before 得; or put the object first and say the verb once.

examples.py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo
examples.en: She sings very well.

examples.py: tā yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài
examples.en: He swims very fast.

examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì jiào shuì de hěn wǎn
examples.en: I went to bed very late last night.

examples.py: tā wǔ tiào de fēi cháng hǎo
examples.en: She dances extremely well.

rules.note: Negation goes in the description, not before the verb: 他唱歌唱得不好.

rules.rule: Result words (完, 好), potential forms (不着, 不了) and 什么 go right after the verb half, before the object half.
rules.pattern: Subject + verb + 完 / 好 / 不着 / 什么 + object

examples.zh: 我吃完饭就给你打电话。
examples.py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
examples.en: I'll call you as soon as I finish eating.

examples.zh: 上完课我们一起去吃饭吧。
examples.py: shàng wán kè wǒ men yī qǐ qù chī fàn ba
examples.en: Let's go and eat together after class.

examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang méi shuì hǎo jiào
examples.en: I didn't sleep well last night.

examples.py: nǐ shēng shén me qì
examples.en: What are you angry about?

rules.note: Same shape as an ordinary verb and object: 吃完饭 is built exactly like 看完书.

right.py: wǒ míng tiān gēn tā jiàn miàn

contrasts.why: 面 already fills the object slot of 见, so 他 cannot follow. The person comes before the verb with 跟.

right.zh: 他跟一个中国人结婚了。
right.py: tā gēn yī gè zhōng guó rén jié hūn le

contrasts.why: English 'marry someone' has an object; 结婚 does not take one. You get married 'with' someone: 跟 + person + 结婚.

right.py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ yī gè máng ma
right.en: Can you do me a favour?

contrasts.why: 帮忙 cannot take 我 after it. Split it (帮我一个忙, 帮我的忙) or use plain 帮: 你能帮我吗.

right.py: tā shēng wǒ de qì le

contrasts.why: The person you are angry with goes inside 生气 as 我的: literally 'she produced my anger'.
过 attaches to the verb 见, not to the noun 面, just as in 吃过饭. 见面过 is heard in casual speech, but 见过面 is the standard form.

right.py: wǒ shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí jiào

contrasts.why: In standard usage 了 and the duration follow the verb 睡 and come before the object 觉. 睡觉睡了八个小时 also works.

right.py: tā jié guo liǎng cì hūn

contrasts.why: 过 and the count 两次 belong inside 结婚 in standard usage: 结 + 过 + 两次 + 婚.

contrasts.wrong: 我们出去散步一散步吧。

right.py: wǒ men chū qù sàn sàn bù ba
right.en: Let's go out for a little walk.

contrasts.why: Only the verb half doubles, and 一 cannot join two whole words: 散散步. (散步散步 is heard in casual speech; AAB is the standard form.)

right.py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo

contrasts.why: 得 cannot follow the noun 歌. Repeat the verb so that 得 sits right after 唱.

right.py: wǒ xǐ wán zǎo jiù shuì jiào
right.en: I'll go to bed as soon as I've had my shower.

contrasts.why: The result word 完 attaches to the verb 洗, before the object 澡, like 吃完饭. (洗澡完 is occasionally heard, but it is not standard.)

cheat: A person after 见面, 结婚, 聊天, 道歉？ Move them in front with 跟 / 和 / 向.
帮忙 and 生气 + person: put 'person + 的' in the middle (帮我的忙, 生他的气).
过, 着, 完, 好, 什么: right after the first character (见过面, 吃完饭).
How long or how many times: verb + 了 + amount + object (睡了八个小时觉, 见过两次面).
结婚, 毕业, 离婚 + time since: whole word first, then the time, then 了 (结婚十年了).
'A bit of': double the first character only (散散步, 聊聊天).
得 must touch a verb: 唱歌唱得好, never 唱歌得好.

items.q: 明天下午我想___老师见面。
items.zh: 明天下午我想跟老师见面。
items.py: míng tiān xià wǔ wǒ xiǎng gēn lǎo shī jiàn miàn
items.en: I'd like to meet the teacher tomorrow afternoon.
items.why: 见面 already contains its object 面, so the teacher cannot follow it. 跟 brings the other person in before the verb; 见 or 把 or nothing leaves 老师 with no place in the sentence.

items.q: 他上个月___一个同事结婚了。
items.zh: 他上个月跟一个同事结婚了。
items.py: tā shàng gè yuè gēn yí gè tóng shì jié hūn le
items.en: He married a colleague last month.
items.why: 结婚 takes no object, so the partner is introduced by 跟 before the verb. 对, 把 and 给 do not mean 'together with' and cannot link the spouse to 结婚.

items.q: 你应该___经理道歉，因为你今天迟到了。
items.zh: 你应该向经理道歉，因为你今天迟到了。
items.py: nǐ yīng gāi xiàng jīng lǐ dào qiàn yīn wèi nǐ jīn tiān chí dào le
items.en: You should apologise to the manager, because you were late today.
items.why: 道歉 is verb plus object and cannot take 经理 after it. The person who receives the apology goes before the verb with 向. 把 and 被 change the structure instead of marking a recipient.

items.q: 经理明天要去___。
items.zh: 经理明天要去上海出差。
items.py: jīng lǐ míng tiān yào qù shàng hǎi chū chāi
items.en: The manager is going to Shanghai on a business trip tomorrow.
items.why: The place goes in front: 去上海出差. 出差 already holds its object 差, so a place name cannot sit right after it.

items.q: 你别___我的气了，好不好？
items.zh: 你别生我的气了，好不好？
items.py: nǐ bié shēng wǒ de qì le hǎo bù hǎo
items.en: Stop being angry with me, okay?
items.why: The person you are angry with goes inside 生气 as 我的: 生我的气. 生气 cannot be placed in front of 我的气 because 气 would then appear twice.

items.q: 谢谢你___我的忙，不然我今天做不完。
items.zh: 谢谢你帮了我的忙，不然我今天做不完。
items.py: xiè xiè nǐ bāng le wǒ de máng bù rán wǒ jīn tiān zuò bù wán
items.en: Thanks for helping me out, or I would not have finished today.
items.why: Splitting 帮忙 puts 了 after 帮 and the person with 的 before 忙: 帮了我的忙. 帮忙 whole cannot take 我的忙, and 帮助 never combines with 忙.

items.q: 老师还在生我___气呢。
items.zh: 老师还在生我的气呢。
items.py: lǎo shī hái zài shēng wǒ de qì ne
items.en: The teacher is still angry with me.
items.why: The person inside 生气 is linked to 气 by 的: 生我的气. 了, 着 or 地 cannot do that job between 我 and 气.

items.q: 同事们都很忙，没有人愿意___我的忙，我只好自己做完。
items.zh: 同事们都很忙，没有人愿意帮我的忙，我只好自己做完。
items.py: tóng shì men dōu hěn máng méi yǒu rén yuàn yì bāng wǒ de máng wǒ zhǐ hǎo zì jǐ zuò wán
items.en: My colleagues were all busy and nobody was willing to help me out, so I had to finish it myself.
items.why: Only the verb half 帮 can sit before 我的忙. 帮忙 or 帮忙了 would repeat 忙, and 帮助 takes a person directly but never the word 忙.

items.q: 小王工作很忙，我下班后去___他的忙。
items.zh: 小王工作很忙，我下班后去帮他的忙。
items.py: xiǎo wáng gōng zuò hěn máng wǒ xià bān hòu qù bāng tā de máng
items.en: Xiao Wang is busy at work, so I'm going to give him a hand after work.
items.why: 帮他的忙 is the standard shape for helping a person. 给 would need 给他帮忙 without 的, and 对 or 把 cannot make 忙 mean 'help'.

items.q: 他从来没请___假。
items.zh: 他从来没请过假。
items.py: tā cóng lái méi qǐng guo jià
items.en: He has never taken leave.
items.why: 'Never' (从来没) needs 过 for experience, and 过 attaches to the verb half: 请过假. 没请了假 is impossible, and 着 does not express past experience.

items.q: 他们坐在教室里，一边吃___饭，一边讨论问题。
items.zh: 他们坐在教室里，一边吃着饭，一边讨论问题。
items.py: tā men zuò zài jiào shì lǐ yī biān chī zhe fàn yī biān tǎo lùn wèn tí
items.en: They sat in the classroom, eating while discussing the problem.
items.why: Two actions at once: 着 goes after the verb 吃. 了 and 完 mark a completed action, and 过 means a past experience, so none of them fits 一边…一边.

items.q: 我吃___饭就去找你，你先在图书馆等我。
items.zh: 我吃了饭就去找你，你先在图书馆等我。
items.py: wǒ chī le fàn jiù qù zhǎo nǐ nǐ xiān zài tú shū guǎn děng wǒ
items.en: I'll come and find you as soon as I've eaten, so wait for me at the library first.
items.why: 吃饭 splits so that 了 follows the verb when a second action comes next: 吃了饭就去. 着, 得 and 地 do not mark the first of two sequential actions.

items.q: 他在这家公司工作了十年，从来没跟同事吵___架。
items.zh: 他在这家公司工作了十年，从来没跟同事吵过架。
items.py: tā zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò le shí nián cóng lái méi gēn tóng shì chǎo guo jià
items.en: He has worked at this company for ten years and has never quarrelled with a colleague.
items.why: With 从来没, experience 过 goes right after the verb 吵: 吵过架. 吵了架 and 吵着架 cannot follow 没, and 吵完架 would mean never finishing a fight.

items.q: 我昨天___。
items.zh: 我昨天睡了八个小时觉。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí jiào
items.en: I slept for eight hours yesterday.
items.why: The duration sits between the two halves, after 了: 睡了八个小时觉. 睡觉了八个小时 puts the amount after the whole word, which is not a pattern in Chinese.

items.q: 周末我们聊了一个下午___。
items.zh: 周末我们聊了一个下午的天。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ men liáo le yí gè xià wǔ de tiān
items.en: At the weekend we chatted for a whole afternoon.
items.why: 聊天 splits into 聊 and 天, with the duration and 的 in between: 聊了一个下午的天. Repeating 聊天 afterwards would say the verb twice.

items.q: 他们结婚___了，现在还像刚认识一样。
items.zh: 他们结婚十年了，现在还像刚认识一样。
items.py: tā men jié hūn shí nián le xiàn zài hái xiàng gāng rèn shí yī yàng
items.en: They have been married for ten years and still behave as if they had just met.
items.why: 结婚 happens at a single point, so how long it has been goes after the whole word, followed by sentence-final 了: 结婚十年了. 着 and 过 cannot mark a duration there, and 结了十年婚 does not exist.

items.q: 他离婚___了，现在一个人住。
items.zh: 他离婚三年了，现在一个人住。
items.py: tā lí hūn sān nián le xiàn zài yí gè rén zhù
items.en: He has been divorced for three years and now lives alone.
items.why: Like 结婚, 离婚 is a point-like event: time since goes after the whole word and 了 ends the sentence: 离婚三年了. 着 or 过 before the time breaks that pattern.

items.q: 她昨天游泳游___一个小时。
items.zh: 她昨天游泳游了一个小时。
items.py: tā zuó tiān yóu yǒng yóu le yí gè xiǎo shí
items.en: She swam for an hour yesterday.
items.why: 游泳游了一个小时: the repeated verb takes 了 and the duration. 得 would start a description, 着 describes a continuing state, and 过 means 'has ever'.

items.q: 为了准备考试，他昨天晚上只睡___三个小时觉，今天一直没精神。
items.zh: 为了准备考试，他昨天晚上只睡了三个小时觉，今天一直没精神。
items.py: wèi le zhǔn bèi kǎo shì tā zuó tiān wǎn shàng zhǐ shuì le sān gè xiǎo shí jiào jīn tiān yì zhí méi jīng shén
items.en: To prepare for the exam he slept only three hours last night and has been lifeless all day.
items.why: Completed event with a duration: 了 goes after 睡 and before 三个小时觉. 着 and 得 do not mark a finished event, and 的 cannot follow the verb 睡.

items.q: 他生病了，所以向老师请___两天假。
items.zh: 他生病了，所以向老师请了两天假。
items.py: tā shēng bìng le suǒ yǐ xiàng lǎo shī qǐng le liǎng tiān jià
items.en: He was ill, so he asked the teacher for two days off.
items.why: 请了两天假: 了 sits inside the word before the duration. 请着两天假, 请得两天假 and 请地两天假 are not possible.

items.q: 我们只见过两___面。
items.zh: 我们只见过两次面。
items.py: wǒ men zhǐ jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn
items.en: We have only met twice.
items.why: The number of times goes inside 见面 after 过: 见过两次面. 个 counts things, not occasions, and 本 and 天 do not mean 'times'.

items.q: 他结过两___婚，现在一个人住。
items.zh: 他结过两次婚，现在一个人住。
items.py: tā jié guo liǎng cì hūn xiàn zài yí gè rén zhù
items.en: He has been married twice and now lives alone.
items.why: 次 counts occurrences and sits inside 结婚 after 过: 结过两次婚. 年 would be a duration, and 个 or 件 cannot count marriages here.

items.q: 我想先洗___澡，再吃饭。
items.zh: 我想先洗个澡，再吃饭。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng xiān xǐ gè zǎo zài chī fàn
items.en: I'd like to take a shower first, and then eat.
items.why: The casual 个 goes inside 洗澡 and makes the action sound light: 洗个澡. 次, 张 and 本 do not fit 澡.

items.q: 你能不能帮我一___忙？
items.zh: 你能不能帮我一个忙？
items.py: nǐ néng bù néng bāng wǒ yí gè máng
items.en: Could you do me a favour?
items.why: 帮我一个忙 is the set phrase: the person goes right after 帮 and 个 goes between the halves. 件 or 次 cannot count 忙.

items.q: 我下午想去理___发。
items.zh: 我下午想去理个发。
items.py: wǒ xià wǔ xiǎng qù lǐ gè fā
items.en: I want to go and get a haircut this afternoon.
items.why: 个 goes inside 理发 and makes it casual: 理个发. 张, 本 and 把 cannot be put between 理 and 发.

items.q: 他们只见过一___面，就决定在下个月结婚。
items.zh: 他们只见过一次面，就决定在下个月结婚。
items.py: tā men zhǐ jiàn guo yī cì miàn jiù jué dìng zài xià gè yuè jié hūn
items.en: They had met only once before deciding to marry next month.
items.why: The number of times belongs inside the word after 过: 见过一次面. 个, 本 and 件 do not count occasions.

items.q: 吃完饭，我们去公园___吧。
items.zh: 吃完饭，我们去公园散散步吧。
items.py: chī wán fàn wǒ men qù gōng yuán sàn sàn bù ba
items.en: After eating, let's go for a little walk in the park.
items.why: Only the verb half doubles: 散散步. 步 is the object, so repeating the whole word 散步散步 is wrong.

items.q: 周末你有空吗？来我家___吧。
items.zh: 周末你有空吗？来我家聊聊天吧。
items.py: zhōu mò nǐ yǒu kòng ma lái wǒ jiā liáo liáo tiān ba
items.en: Are you free at the weekend? Come over to my place for a chat.
items.why: 聊聊天 doubles only 聊. The whole word 聊天 is verb plus object, and does not double like 休息.

items.q: 这件事我一个人做不完，请你___吧。
items.zh: 这件事我一个人做不完，请你帮帮忙吧。
items.py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ yí gè rén zuò bù wán qǐng nǐ bāng bāng máng ba
items.en: I can't finish this by myself, so please lend a hand.
items.why: The verb half doubles: 帮帮忙. 帮忙帮忙 treats 帮忙 as a single two-syllable verb, which it is not.

items.q: 考试以前太紧张了，我想出去___，放松一下。
items.zh: 考试以前太紧张了，我想出去跑跑步，放松一下。
items.py: kǎo shì yǐ qián tài jǐn zhāng le wǒ xiǎng chū qù pǎo pǎo bù fàng sōng yī xià
items.en: I get so nervous before exams that I want to go out for a little run to relax.
items.why: Double only the verb: 跑跑步. 步 is an object and cannot repeat with the verb.

items.q: 昨天晚上我们在宿舍里___，一点儿也不累。
items.zh: 昨天晚上我们在宿舍里聊了聊天，一点儿也不累。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng wǒ men zài sù shè lǐ liáo le liáo tiān yī diǎn r yě bù lèi
items.en: Last night we had a little chat in the dormitory and were not tired at all.
items.why: In a finished doubled action 了 goes between the two verbs and the object follows: 聊了聊天. 聊天了聊 breaks the word apart in the wrong place.

items.q: 我哥哥游泳游___很快。
items.zh: 我哥哥游泳游得很快。
items.py: wǒ gē gē yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài
items.en: My older brother swims very fast.
items.why: After 游泳 the verb 游 repeats, then 得 introduces the description: 游得很快. 了 and 着 would mark aspect, and 的 cannot join a verb to its result.

items.q: 她舞___非常好，老师都夸她。
items.zh: 她舞跳得非常好，老师都夸她。
items.py: tā wǔ tiào de fēi cháng hǎo lǎo shī dōu kuā tā
items.en: She dances extremely well, and the teacher praises her.
items.why: With the object 舞 first, the verb appears once before 得: 舞跳得非常好. 跳了 only reports a finished act, and bare 得 or 的 cannot sit after the noun 舞.

items.q: 昨晚我睡觉___太晚了，今天很累。
items.zh: 昨晚我睡觉睡得太晚了，今天很累。
items.py: zuó wǎn wǒ shuì jiào shuì de tài wǎn le jīn tiān hěn lèi
items.en: I went to bed far too late last night, so I'm tired today.
items.why: 睡觉 repeats its verb before 得: 睡觉睡得太晚了. 得 straight after 觉 does not work, because 觉 is a noun, and 睡了 lacks the description.

items.q: 我同学唱歌唱___不好，可是她特别喜欢参加比赛。
items.zh: 我同学唱歌唱得不好，可是她特别喜欢参加比赛。
items.py: wǒ tóng xué chàng gē chàng de bù hǎo kě shì tā tè bié xǐ huān cān jiā bǐ sài
items.en: My classmate does not sing well, but she really likes to enter competitions.
items.why: 得 comes right after the repeated verb 唱 and introduces the negative description 不好. 的, 了 and 地 cannot link a verb to its result.

items.q: 我吃___饭就去上课。
items.zh: 我吃完饭就去上课。
items.py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù shàng kè
items.en: I'll go to class as soon as I've finished eating.
items.why: The result word 完 goes right after 吃 and before 饭: 吃完饭. 吃到饭 would mean 'managed to get a meal'.

items.q: 昨天晚上太吵了，我没睡___觉。
items.zh: 昨天晚上太吵了，我没睡好觉。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng tài chǎo le wǒ méi shuì hǎo jiào
items.en: Last night was so noisy that I didn't sleep well.
items.why: 没睡好觉: 好 is the result complement between the halves of 睡觉. 对, 去 and 给 do not describe how well one slept.

items.q: 我最近很担心考试，晚上总是睡___觉。
items.zh: 我最近很担心考试，晚上总是睡不着觉。
items.py: wǒ zuì jìn hěn dān xīn kǎo shì wǎn shàng zǒng shì shuì bù zháo jiào
items.en: I've been worrying about the exam, and I can never fall asleep at night.
items.why: The potential 不着 sits after 睡 and before 觉: 睡不着觉. 睡着不觉 puts the pieces in the wrong order and 没着 is not a result form.

items.q: 你到底生___气？说出来吧。
items.zh: 你到底生什么气？说出来吧。
items.py: nǐ dào dǐ shēng shén me qì shuō chū lái ba
items.en: What exactly are you angry about? Say it out loud.
items.why: The question word goes inside the word: 生什么气. 怎么, 哪 and 为 cannot follow the verb 生 and take 气.

items.q: 上___课，我们一起去操场打篮球吧。
items.zh: 上完课，我们一起去操场打篮球吧。
items.py: shàng wán kè wǒ men yì qǐ qù cāo chǎng dǎ lán qiú ba
items.en: Let's play basketball on the sports field together after class.
items.why: 'After class finishes' needs the result word 完 inside 上课: 上完课. 着 describes ongoing class, and 到 or 给 cannot mean 'having finished'.

items.q: 他每天忙到半夜，常常洗___澡就倒在床上睡着了。
items.zh: 他每天忙到半夜，常常洗完澡就倒在床上睡着了。
items.py: tā měi tiān máng dào bàn yè cháng cháng xǐ wán zǎo jiù dào zài chuáng shàng shuì zháo le
items.en: He is busy until midnight every day and often falls asleep on the bed as soon as he has finished his shower.
items.why: 完 goes after 洗 and before 澡: 洗完澡. 着, 到 and 得 do not mean 'finished'. 洗过澡 would also be heard, so 过 is not offered.

items.zh: 我想跟老师见面。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn lǎo shī jiàn miàn
items.en: I'd like to meet the teacher.
items.why: The teacher goes before the verb with 跟, and 见面 comes last. 见面老师 is impossible because 见面 already has an object.

items.zh: 小王跟一个同事结婚了。
items.py: xiǎo wáng gēn yí gè tóng shì jié hūn le
items.en: Xiao Wang married a colleague.
items.why: The spouse comes after 跟 and before 结婚. 结婚 cannot take the colleague as an object, so 结婚一个同事 fails.

items.zh: 我应该向她道歉。
items.py: wǒ yīng gāi xiàng tā dào qiàn
items.en: I should apologise to her.
items.why: 向 plus the person goes before 道歉. 道歉她 is wrong because 歉 already is the object.

items.zh: 谢谢你帮了我的忙。
items.py: xiè xiè nǐ bāng le wǒ de máng
items.en: Thank you for helping me out.
items.why: The person sits inside the word as 我的: 帮了我的忙. 帮忙 whole cannot be followed by 我.

items.zh: 妈妈还在生我的气。
items.py: mā mā hái zài shēng wǒ de qì
items.en: Mum is still angry with me.
items.why: 生我的气: the person who is the target goes inside 生气 with 的. 生气我 is impossible.

items.zh: 我们在北京见过面。
items.py: wǒ men zài běi jīng jiàn guo miàn
items.en: We have met in Beijing.
items.why: 过 attaches to the verb 见, and 面 follows: 见过面. 见面过 puts 过 on the noun half. The place phrase stays before the verb.

items.zh: 他们从来没吵过架。
items.py: tā men cóng lái méi chǎo guo jià
items.en: They have never quarrelled.
items.why: 没 + verb + 过 + object: 没吵过架. 过 stays on 吵, so 没吵架过 fails.

items.zh: 他们离婚已经三年了。
items.py: tā men lí hūn yǐ jīng sān nián le
items.en: They have been divorced for three years.
items.why: 离婚 is a point-like event, so time since follows the whole word and 了 closes it: 离婚三年了. 离了三年婚 is wrong.

items.zh: 为了准备考试他昨天只睡了四个小时觉。
items.py: wèi le zhǔn bèi kǎo shì tā zuó tiān zhǐ shuì le sì gè xiǎo shí jiào
items.en: To prepare for the exam he slept only four hours yesterday.
items.why: 睡了四个小时觉: 了 and the duration come between 睡 and 觉. 觉 is last, and 只 stays before the verb.

items.zh: 我哥哥只结过一次婚。
items.py: wǒ gē ge zhǐ jié guo yī cì hūn
items.en: My older brother has only been married once.
items.why: 一次 goes inside 结婚 after 过: 结过一次婚. 结婚过一次 is the classic wrong order.

items.zh: 经理今天开了三个会。
items.py: jīng lǐ jīn tiān kāi le sān gè huì
items.en: The manager held three meetings today.
items.why: The count goes inside 开会 after 了: 开了三个会. 开会了三个 is wrong.

items.zh: 我想先洗个澡。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng xiān xǐ gè zǎo
items.en: I'd like to take a shower first.
items.why: 个 goes between 洗 and 澡 for a casual single action: 洗个澡. 洗澡个 is impossible.

items.zh: 周末我喜欢在家唱唱歌。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ xǐ huān zài jiā chàng chàng gē
items.en: At weekends I like to sing a bit at home.
items.why: Only 唱 doubles: 唱唱歌. 唱歌唱歌 repeats the object as well.

items.zh: 有空来我家聊聊天。
items.py: yǒu kòng lái wǒ jiā liáo liáo tiān
items.en: Drop by my place for a chat when you have time.
items.why: 聊聊天: the first half doubles and 天 stays single. 聊天聊天 is wrong.

items.zh: 昨天我睡觉睡得很晚。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ shuì jiào shuì de hěn wǎn
items.en: I went to bed very late yesterday.
items.why: Repeat the verb: 睡觉睡得很晚. 得 cannot come directly after the noun 觉.

items.zh: 你吃完饭就来找我。
items.py: nǐ chī wán fàn jiù lái zhǎo wǒ
items.en: Come and find me as soon as you've finished eating.
items.why: 完 goes inside 吃饭: 吃完饭. 吃饭完 is the learners' mistake.

items.zh: 昨晚我没睡好觉。
items.py: zuó wǎn wǒ méi shuì hǎo jiào
items.en: I didn't sleep well last night.
items.why: 没睡好觉: the result 好 is placed between 睡 and 觉, after the negation. 睡觉好 is wrong.

items.zh: 下班以后我洗完澡就睡觉了。
items.py: xià bān yǐ hòu wǒ xǐ wán zǎo jiù shuì jiào le
items.en: After work I went to bed as soon as I had finished my shower.
items.why: 洗完澡: the result goes inside the word. 就 links the two actions, and 澡 stays after 完.

items.src_py: wǒ men jiàn miàn le
items.task: Say that it has happened before (use 过).
items.zh: 我们见过面。
items.py: wǒ men jiàn guo miàn
items.en: We have met before.
items.why: Experience 过 attaches to 见: 见过面. 见面过 puts it on the noun half.

items.src_py: wǒ shuì jiào shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí
items.task: Move the duration inside the word.
items.zh: 我睡了八个小时觉。
items.py: wǒ shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí jiào
items.en: I slept for eight hours.
items.why: The other correct pattern puts the duration between the halves: 睡了八个小时觉. Putting it after 觉 with 了 on 睡觉 would be wrong.

items.src_py: wǒ men qù gōng yuán sàn bù
items.task: Say "take a little walk" by doubling.
items.zh: 我们去公园散散步。
items.py: wǒ men qù gōng yuán sàn sàn bù
items.en: We go for a little walk in the park.
items.why: Double only the verb half: 散散步. 散步散步 repeats the whole word and is wrong.

items.src_py: tā xiǎng jiàn jīng lǐ
items.task: Say he wants to meet the manager using 见面 and 跟.
items.zh: 他想跟经理见面。
items.py: tā xiǎng gēn jīng lǐ jiàn miàn
items.en: He wants to meet the manager.
items.why: 见面 has no room for an object, so the person goes before it with 跟: 跟经理见面.

items.src_py: mā mā shēng qì le
items.task: Say she is angry with me (use 我的).
items.zh: 妈妈生我的气了。
items.py: mā mā shēng wǒ de qì le
items.en: Mum is angry with me.
items.why: The target goes inside 生气: 生我的气. 生气我 is wrong.

items.src_py: tā de gē chàng de hěn hǎo
items.task: Say it with the verb repeated, starting with 他唱歌.
items.zh: 他唱歌唱得很好。
items.py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo
items.en: He sings very well.
items.why: 唱歌唱得很好: 唱 repeats right before 得. 他唱歌得很好 breaks the rule that 得 must follow a verb.

items.src_py: tā xǐ zǎo rán hòu kàn shū
items.task: Say he reads as soon as he has finished (use 完 and 就).
items.zh: 他洗完澡就看书。
items.py: tā xǐ wán zǎo jiù kàn shū
items.en: He reads as soon as he has finished his shower.
items.why: 完 goes inside 洗澡: 洗完澡. 洗澡完 is the mistake.

items.src_py: tā jié hūn le
items.task: Say he has been married twice (use 过 and 两次).
items.zh: 他结过两次婚。
items.py: tā jié guo liǎng cì hūn
items.en: He has been married twice.
items.why: 过 and 两次 go inside 结婚: 结过两次婚. 结婚过两次 is wrong.

items.src: 我姐姐三年前大学毕业。
items.src_py: wǒ jiě jiě sān nián qián dà xué bì yè
items.task: Say it has been three years since she graduated.
items.zh: 我姐姐大学毕业三年了。
items.py: wǒ jiě jiě dà xué bì yè sān nián le
items.en: It has been three years since my older sister graduated from university.
items.why: 毕业 happens at a point, so the time since goes after the whole word and 了 ends the sentence: 毕业三年了. 毕了三年业 is impossible.

items.src_py: tā zài lǎo shī miàn qián dào qiàn le
items.task: Say he apologised to the teacher using 向.
items.zh: 他向老师道歉了。
items.py: tā xiàng lǎo shī dào qiàn le
items.en: He apologised to the teacher.
items.why: 向 + person goes before 道歉. 道歉老师 is wrong since 歉 is already the object.

items.s: 他去年结婚了一个在上海工作的同学。
items.zh: 他去年跟一个在上海工作的同学结婚了。
items.en: Last year he married a classmate who works in Shanghai.
items.why: 结婚 takes no object. The spouse is introduced by 跟 before the verb, even when the noun is long.
items.s_py: tā qù nián jié hūn le yí gè zài shàng hǎi gōng zuò de tóng xué
items.py: tā qù nián gēn yí gè zài shàng hǎi gōng zuò de tóng xué jié hūn le

items.s: 我昨天晚上聊天了小王。
items.zh: 我昨天晚上跟小王聊天了。
items.en: I chatted with Xiao Wang last night.
items.why: 聊天 has 天 as its object, so 小王 cannot follow. 跟 brings him in before the verb.
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shàng liáo tiān le xiǎo wáng
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shàng gēn xiǎo wáng liáo tiān le

items.s: 他做错了事，所以道歉了老师。
items.zh: 他做错了事，所以向老师道歉了。
items.en: He had done something wrong, so he apologised to the teacher.
items.why: 道歉 cannot take a person after it. The teacher goes in front with 向.
items.s_py: tā zuò cuò le shì suǒ yǐ dào qiàn le lǎo shī
items.py: tā zuò cuò le shì suǒ yǐ xiàng lǎo shī dào qiàn le

items.s: 你别生气我了。
items.zh: 你别生我的气了。
items.en: Stop being angry with me.
items.why: The target of the anger goes inside the word as 我的: 生我的气. 生气我 is impossible.
items.s_py: nǐ bié shēng qì wǒ le
items.py: nǐ bié shēng wǒ de qì le

items.s: 他帮忙我做完了作业。

items.q: 我们以前没见___面，今天是第一次。
items.zh: 我们以前没见过面，今天是第一次。

items.q: 弟弟昨天睡觉睡___很晚，今天起不来。

items.s: 奶奶每天午饭后都睡半个小时觉。

items.s: 他们离婚三年了，孩子跟妈妈住。

items.s: 你别担心我，我一个人在家没问题。
items.s_py: nǐ bié dān xīn wǒ wǒ yí gè rén zài jiā méi wèn tí

items.py: nǐ bié dān xīn wǒ wǒ yí gè rén zài jiā méi wèn tí
items.en: Don't worry about me; I'll be fine at home alone.

items.zh: 孩子们在院子里跳着舞。
items.py: hái zi men zài yuàn zi lǐ tiào zhe wǔ
items.en: The children are dancing in the yard.
items.why: 着 attaches to the verb half 跳 and the object 舞 follows: 跳着舞. 跳舞着 would put 着 after the noun.

items.q: 我的钱包丢了，多亏你帮了我这么大的___，真不知道怎么感谢你。
items.zh: 我的钱包丢了，多亏你帮了我这么大的忙，真不知道怎么感谢你。

items.en: My wallet was lost and thanks to you helping me so much, I really don't know how to thank you.
items.why: 帮…的忙 splits 帮忙 around the person and 的; 这么大的 describes the 忙. 气, 面 and 觉 are the second halves of other separable verbs and cannot be paired with 帮.

items.q: 晚饭后，我们在客厅聊___聊天，然后就睡觉了。
items.zh: 晚饭后，我们在客厅聊了聊天，然后就睡觉了。

items.en: After dinner we had a little chat in the living room and then went to bed.
items.why: A finished brief action puts 了 between the two copies of the verb: 聊了聊天. 着, 过 and 的 cannot go between the doubled verbs.

items.s: 周末我们去公园散散步吧。
items.s_py: zhōu mò wǒ men qù gōng yuán sàn sàn bù ba
items.zh: 周末我们去公园散散步吧。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ men qù gōng yuán sàn sàn bù ba
