items.zh: 我哥哥大学毕业两年了，现在在上海上班。
items.py: wǒ gē gē dà xué bì yè liǎng nián le xiàn zài zài shàng hǎi shàng bān
items.en: It has been two years since my older brother graduated from university, and now he works in Shanghai.
items.why: 毕业 is a point event, so the time elapsed since it follows the whole word: 毕业两年了. Putting 了 or 过 inside the word would turn it into something that lasted.

items.s: 我今天想早点回家，睡个好觉。
items.s_py: wǒ jīn tiān xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā shuì gè hǎo jiào
items.zh: 我今天想早点回家，睡个好觉。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā shuì gè hǎo jiào
items.en: I want to go home early today and get a good night's sleep.
items.why: 睡个好觉 is correct: 个 plus a describing word goes inside the word, like 洗个热水澡. Nothing here needs fixing.

items.q: 我还没吃___饭，等我一下。
items.zh: 我还没吃完饭，等我一下。
items.py: wǒ hái méi chī wán fàn děng wǒ yī xià
items.en: I haven't finished eating yet; wait for me a moment.
items.why: Result words go between the halves: 吃完饭. 还没 stresses an unfinished result, so 完 is needed; 了 and 过 do not carry that meaning.

items.s: 孩子睡不着觉，一直在床上翻来翻去。
items.s_py: hái zi shuì bù zháo jiào yì zhí zài chuáng shàng fān lái fān qù
items.zh: 孩子睡不着觉，一直在床上翻来翻去。
items.py: hái zi shuì bù zháo jiào yì zhí zài chuáng shàng fān lái fān qù
items.en: The child can't sleep and keeps tossing and turning in bed.
items.why: 睡不着觉 is correct: the potential 不着 sits inside the word. The tempting error 睡觉不着 is what a learner would write.

items.q: 我一个人搬不了这个沙发，你能来___吗？
items.zh: 我一个人搬不了这个沙发，你能来帮帮忙吗？
items.py: wǒ yí gè rén bān bù liǎo zhè ge shā fā nǐ néng lái bāng bāng máng ma
items.en: I can't move this sofa on my own; can you come and lend a hand?
items.why: The first half doubles: 帮帮忙. 帮忙帮忙 treats the word as an ordinary two-syllable verb. 帮忙忙 and 忙帮忙 are not possible forms.

items.q: 你生___气？是不是有人惹你了？
items.zh: 你生什么气？是不是有人惹你了？
items.py: nǐ shēng shén me qì shì bú shì yǒu rén rě nǐ le
items.en: What are you angry about? Did someone upset you?
items.why: 什么 goes inside the word as a question word: 生什么气. 怎么, 为什么 and 哪里 are placed before the verb, not inside it.

items.q: 孩子们一边在院子里跳___舞，一边大声地笑。
items.zh: 孩子们一边在院子里跳着舞，一边大声地笑。
items.py: hái zi men yī biān zài yuàn zi lǐ tiào zhe wǔ yī biān dà shēng de xiào
items.en: The children were dancing in the yard and laughing loudly at the same time.
items.why: 一边…一边 describes two simultaneous ongoing actions, so the first verb takes 着 inside 跳舞: 跳着舞. 了, 过 and 完 would all close the action off.

items.zh: 妈妈没生你的气。
items.py: mā mā méi shēng nǐ de qì
items.en: Mum isn't angry with you.
items.why: The person goes inside 生气 as 你的; 没 negates the verb 生 in front.

items.src_py: tā tiào wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo
items.task: Put the object first and say the verb once.
items.zh: 他舞跳得很好。
items.py: tā wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo
items.en: He dances very well.
items.why: The object 舞 is fronted and the verb is said once: 舞跳得很好. The repeated verb is only needed when the object follows it.

items.s: 孩子们唱歌着，大家都很高兴。
items.s_py: hái zi men chàng gē zhe dà jiā dōu hěn gāo xìng
items.zh: 孩子们唱着歌，大家都很高兴。
items.py: hái zi men chàng zhe gē dà jiā dōu hěn gāo xìng
items.en: The children were singing and everyone was happy.
items.why: 着 must attach to the verb half 唱, giving 唱着歌. 唱歌着 puts it after the object.

items.s: 孩子们昨天在学校打了一架。
items.s_py: hái zi men zuó tiān zài xué xiào dǎ le yī jià
items.zh: 孩子们昨天在学校打了一架。
items.py: hái zi men zuó tiān zài xué xiào dǎ le yī jià
items.en: The children had a fight at school yesterday.
items.why: 打了一架 is correct: a count can go after 了 with 一, and here 架 is simply the object slot. It is a correct, natural sentence.

items.zh: 我们没见过面。
items.py: wǒ men méi jiàn guo miàn
items.en: We have never met before.
items.why: 过 goes right after the verb half 见, not after 面: 见过面. 没 comes before the whole phrase.

items.q: 周末有空的话，来我家___吧。
items.zh: 周末有空的话，来我家聊聊天吧。
items.py: zhōu mò yǒu kòng de huà lái wǒ jiā liáo liáo tiān ba
items.en: If you are free at the weekend, come to my place for a chat.
items.why: To say "a bit of" only the verb half 聊 is doubled: 聊聊天. 聊天聊天 is the ordinary-verb pattern, which does not work here.

items.q: 爸爸下个星期要___上海出差，所以不能陪我们去买东西。
items.zh: 爸爸下个星期要去上海出差，所以不能陪我们去买东西。
items.py: bà bà xià gè xīng qī yào qù shàng hǎi chū chāi suǒ yǐ bù néng péi wǒ men qù mǎi dōng xī
items.en: Dad is going to Shanghai on business next week, so he cannot go shopping with us.
items.why: 出差 cannot take 上海 after it, so the destination is brought in front with 去 (go to Shanghai to do business). 把, 对 and 给 do not mean "go to" a place.

items.zh: 他只结过一次婚。
items.py: tā zhǐ jié guo yī cì hūn
items.en: He has only been married once.
items.why: 过 and the count 一次 both go inside 结婚: 结过一次婚.

items.src_py: dì di chàng de hěn hǎo tīng
items.task: Say what he is good at: add 唱歌 and repeat the verb.
items.zh: 弟弟唱歌唱得很好听。
items.py: dì di chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo tīng
items.en: My younger brother sings beautifully.
items.why: Adding the object 歌 means the verb must repeat before 得: 唱歌唱得很好听.

items.s: 他们结了十年婚，感情还是很好。
items.s_py: tā men jié le shí nián hūn gǎn qíng hái shì hěn hǎo
items.zh: 他们结婚十年了，感情还是很好。
items.py: tā men jié hūn shí nián le gǎn qíng hái shì hěn hǎo
items.en: They have been married for ten years and still get on well.
items.why: 结婚 happens at a point, so a duration cannot be placed inside it. The time since the wedding goes after 结婚 and 了 ends the clause.

items.q: 昨天吃完饭，我们去公园___，然后就回家了。
items.zh: 昨天吃完饭，我们去公园散了散步，然后就回家了。
items.py: zuó tiān chī wán fàn wǒ men qù gōng yuán sàn le sàn bù rán hòu jiù huí jiā le
items.en: After dinner yesterday we went to the park for a little walk and then went home.
items.why: A finished little walk puts 了 between the two copies of the verb half: 散了散步. The object 步 never doubles, so 散步了散步 and 散步散了步 are not possible.

items.s: 我们在商场见过面两次。
items.s_py: wǒ men zài shāng chǎng jiàn guo miàn liǎng cì
items.zh: 我们在商场见过两次面。
items.py: wǒ men zài shāng chǎng jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn
items.en: We have met twice at the mall.
items.why: The count 两次 goes inside 见面, between 过 and 面. After 面 it would be a second object slot.

items.s: 你能帮我吗？我一个人拿不了这些东西。
items.s_py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ ma wǒ yí gè rén ná bù liǎo zhè xiē dōng xī
items.zh: 你能帮我吗？我一个人拿不了这些东西。
items.py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ ma wǒ yí gè rén ná bù liǎo zhè xiē dōng xī
items.en: Can you help me? I can't carry all this by myself.
items.why: 帮 on its own can take 我 directly. The ban applies only to the whole word 帮忙 followed by a person, so this correct sentence is not an error.

items.q: 孩子还没洗___澡，不能马上出门。
items.zh: 孩子还没洗完澡，不能马上出门。
items.py: hái zi hái méi xǐ wán zǎo bù néng mǎ shàng chū mén
items.en: The child hasn't finished washing yet, so we can't go out right away.
items.why: Result 完 sits between 洗 and 澡: 洗完澡. The sense of "not finished yet" rules out 过 and 着, and 到 does not fit a bath.

items.q: 老板昨天开___一个下午的会，没有来店里。
items.zh: 老板昨天开了一个下午的会，没有来店里。
items.py: lǎo bǎn zuó tiān kāi le yí gè xià wǔ de huì méi yǒu lái diàn lǐ
items.en: The shop owner spent yesterday afternoon in a meeting and did not come to the shop.
items.why: Duration of a finished meeting: verb 了 + length + 的 + object, so 开了一个下午的会. 过 would turn it into an experience, and 着 or 完 are not used with a measured duration here.

items.s: 我们放假了，可以去外婆家玩。
items.s_py: wǒ men fàng jià le kě yǐ qù wài pó jiā wán
items.zh: 我们放假了，可以去外婆家玩。
items.py: wǒ men fàng jià le kě yǐ qù wài pó jiā wán
items.en: We are on holiday now, so we can go to Grandma's to play.
items.why: 放假了 with 了 at the end of the clause reports a new situation. It is correct, and splitting it into 放了假 would not be needed.

items.zh: 我们去海边散散步吧。
items.py: wǒ men qù hǎi biān sàn sàn bù ba
items.en: Let's go for a little walk by the sea.
items.why: Only the first half 散 is repeated: 散散步. 散步散步 does not exist.

items.s: 你太累了，回家休息休息吧。
items.s_py: nǐ tài lèi le huí jiā xiū xī xiū xī ba
items.zh: 你太累了，回家休息休息吧。
items.py: nǐ tài lèi le huí jiā xiū xī xiū xī ba
items.en: You are too tired; go home and rest for a bit.
items.why: 休息 is a normal verb and doubles as a whole word. This looks like the 散步散步 error but is correct.

items.zh: 她舞跳得非常好。
items.py: tā wǔ tiào de fēi cháng hǎo
items.en: She dances extremely well.
items.why: With the object put first, the verb is said once and 得 follows it directly: 舞跳得非常好.

items.zh: 妹妹睡了九个小时觉。
items.py: mèi mèi shuì le jiǔ gè xiǎo shí jiào
items.en: My younger sister slept for nine hours.
items.why: 了 and the duration both go between 睡 and 觉: 睡了九个小时觉. 睡觉了九个小时 is a classic error.

items.q: 天太热了，我想先洗___澡再出门。
items.zh: 天太热了，我想先洗个澡再出门。
items.py: tiān tài rè le wǒ xiǎng xiān xǐ gè zǎo zài chū mén
items.en: It is so hot; I would like to take a shower before going out.
items.why: The casual 个 goes inside 洗澡 to make it a light, single shower: 洗个澡. 次, 本 and 张 do not fit a bath.

items.s: 他们已经结婚了，下个月搬家。
items.s_py: tā men yǐ jīng jié hūn le xià gè yuè bān jiā
items.zh: 他们已经结婚了，下个月搬家。
items.py: tā men yǐ jīng jié hūn le xià gè yuè bān jiā
items.en: They are already married and will move house next month.
items.why: Sentence-final 了 after the whole word marks a change of state and is correct here. The rule about moving 了 inside only applies to verb 了 with a following clause or a count.

items.q: 爸爸上个月请___三天假，带我们去旅游。
items.zh: 爸爸上个月请了三天假，带我们去旅游。
items.py: bà bà shàng gè yuè qǐng le sān tiān jià dài wǒ men qù lǚ yóu
items.en: Last month Dad took three days off and took us travelling.
items.why: A specific completed leave of three days takes 了 inside the word: 请了三天假. 过 would only say he has had such leave at some time, and 着 and 完 do not fit.

items.q: 爸爸游泳___得很快。
items.zh: 爸爸游泳游得很快。
items.py: bà bà yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài
items.en: Dad swims very fast.
items.why: The verb repeats so that 得 can attach to it: 游泳游得很快. Dropping the repeated verb leaves 得 after 泳, which is wrong.

items.s: 我吃饭完了，你呢？
items.s_py: wǒ chī fàn wán le nǐ ne
items.zh: 我吃完饭了，你呢？
items.py: wǒ chī wán fàn le nǐ ne
items.en: I have finished eating; how about you?
items.why: 完 is a result complement that must follow the verb 吃 directly, before the object 饭. 吃饭完 puts it after the object.

items.src_py: tā jié hūn le
items.task: Say he has been married before (experience), using 过.
items.zh: 他结过婚。
items.py: tā jié guo hūn
items.en: He has been married before.
items.why: Experience 过 attaches to the verb half: 结过婚. 结婚过 and 结婚了 would not express "has been married before".

items.q: 我昨天___妈妈的气了，因为她不让我出去玩。
items.zh: 我昨天生妈妈的气了，因为她不让我出去玩。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān shēng mā mā de qì le yīn wèi tā bù ràng wǒ chū qù wán
items.en: I was angry with Mum yesterday because she wouldn't let me go out to play.
items.why: 生 + person + 的 + 气 is the frame, so the verb 生 must come right before 妈妈的. 对, 给 and 和 cannot take 妈妈的气 as their object.

items.zh: 爸爸要去上海出差。
items.py: bà bà yào qù shàng hǎi chū chāi
items.en: Dad is going to Shanghai on business.
items.why: Place goes after 去 and before the verb 出差; 出差上海 would put an object after a verb that already holds its object.

items.q: 昨晚隔壁在装修，我没睡___觉，今天很困。
items.zh: 昨晚隔壁在装修，我没睡好觉，今天很困。
items.py: zuó wǎn gé bì zài zhuāng xiū wǒ méi shuì hǎo jiào jīn tiān hěn kùn
items.en: The neighbours were renovating last night, so I didn't sleep well and I'm sleepy today.
items.why: 没睡好觉 uses 好 as a result inside the word. 完 would mean the sleep was not finished, 过 means never, and 了 cannot follow 没.

items.zh: 孩子们洗完澡就睡觉了。
items.py: hái zi men xǐ wán zǎo jiù shuì jiào le
items.en: The children went to sleep as soon as they had finished bathing.
items.why: 完 is inside the first word: 洗完澡. 洗澡完 is wrong because 完 must attach to the verb.

items.s: 我们上课完就去商店买东西。
items.s_py: wǒ men shàng kè wán jiù qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xī
items.zh: 我们上完课就去商店买东西。
items.py: wǒ men shàng wán kè jiù qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xī
items.en: We will go and buy things at the shop as soon as class finishes.
items.why: 完 belongs between 上 and 课, like 吃完饭. 上课完 puts the result after the object.

items.q: 老板娘算账算___特别快，从来不用计算器。
items.zh: 老板娘算账算得特别快，从来不用计算器。
items.py: lǎo bǎn niáng suàn zhàng suàn de tè bié kuài cóng lái bù yòng jì suàn qì
items.en: The owner's wife adds up the bills especially fast and never uses a calculator.
items.why: 得 links the repeated verb 算 to 特别快. 地 would modify a following verb, and 着 or 过 cannot introduce a degree description.

items.q: 我们正在客厅说___话，奶奶突然回来了。
items.zh: 我们正在客厅说着话，奶奶突然回来了。
items.py: wǒ men zhèng zài kè tīng shuō zhe huà nǎi nǎi tū rán huí lái le
items.en: We were chatting in the living room when Grandma suddenly came back.
items.why: An action in progress when something interrupts takes 着 attached to the verb half: 说着话. 过 or 完 would end the action and 了 would report it as finished.

items.q: 妈妈，您别生___的气了，我下次一定早点回家。
items.zh: 妈妈，您别生我的气了，我下次一定早点回家。
items.py: mā mā nín bié shēng wǒ de qì le wǒ xià cì yí dìng zǎo diǎn huí jiā
items.en: Mum, please don't be angry with me; next time I'll definitely come home earlier.
items.why: The pattern is 生 + person + 的 + 气, so only the bare 我 fits before 的气. 对我, 给我 or 跟我 cannot stand in front of 的气.

items.src_py: wǒ men qù hé biān sàn bù
items.task: Make it casual, "a little walk", by doubling.
items.zh: 我们去河边散散步。
items.py: wǒ men qù hé biān sàn sàn bù
items.en: Let's go for a little walk by the river.
items.why: Double only the verb half: 散散步. The object 步 stays alone.

items.q: 我昨晚睡___着觉，一直在想今天的考试。
items.zh: 我昨晚睡不着觉，一直在想今天的考试。
items.py: wǒ zuó wǎn shuì bù zháo jiào yì zhí zài xiǎng jīn tiān de kǎo shì
items.en: I couldn't fall asleep last night; I kept thinking about today's exam.
items.why: Potential form: 睡不着觉, with 不 between the verb and the result 着. 没, 别 and 不会 cannot sit between a verb and its result.

items.q: 我今天在理发店理___发，才花了三十块。
items.zh: 我今天在理发店理个发，才花了三十块。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān zài lǐ fà diàn lǐ gè fā cái huā le sān shí kuài
items.en: I got a haircut at the barber's today and it cost only thirty yuan.
items.why: 个 inside 理发 gives a casual, single haircut: 理个发. 次, 本 and 张 do not fit and would be wrong whatever the price.

items.s: 晚上我想在家唱唱歌。
items.s_py: wǎn shàng wǒ xiǎng zài jiā chàng chàng gē
items.zh: 晚上我想在家唱唱歌。
items.py: wǎn shàng wǒ xiǎng zài jiā chàng chàng gē
items.en: I'd like to sing a bit at home tonight.
items.why: 唱歌 is verb + object, so only 唱 doubles: 唱唱歌. This is the correct casual form, and it looks like a trap if you expect the whole word to repeat.

items.s: 我爸爸游泳游得不太快，但是他游得很远。
items.s_py: wǒ bà bà yóu yǒng yóu de bù tài kuài dàn shì tā yóu de hěn yuǎn
items.zh: 我爸爸游泳游得不太快，但是他游得很远。
items.py: wǒ bà bà yóu yǒng yóu de bù tài kuài dàn shì tā yóu de hěn yuǎn
items.en: My dad is not a very fast swimmer, but he can swim a long way.
items.why: The second clause drops the object because 游泳 was already mentioned, so 他游得很久 is fine. The first clause repeats the verb correctly.

items.q: 哥哥和我小时候从来没打___架，感情一直很好。
items.zh: 哥哥和我小时候从来没打过架，感情一直很好。
items.py: gē gē hé wǒ xiǎo shí hòu cóng lái méi dǎ guo jià gǎn qíng yì zhí hěn hǎo
items.en: My brother and I never fought as children, and we have always got on well.
items.why: Never having done something takes 没…过, with 过 right after 打: 打过架. 没 rules out 了, and 着 and 完 do not mean experience.

items.s: 我想在商场门口见面你。
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎng zài shāng chǎng mén kǒu jiàn miàn nǐ
items.zh: 我想在商场门口跟你见面。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng zài shāng chǎng mén kǒu gēn nǐ jiàn miàn
items.en: I'd like to meet you at the entrance of the shopping mall.
items.why: 见面 already has its object 面, so 你 cannot follow it. English "meet you" must become 跟你见面, with the person before the verb.

items.q: 我一个人搬不动这个冰箱，你能不能帮我___忙？
items.zh: 我一个人搬不动这个冰箱，你能不能帮我一个忙？
items.py: wǒ yí gè rén bān bù dòng zhè ge bīng xiāng nǐ néng bù néng bāng wǒ yí gè máng
items.en: I can't move this fridge by myself; could you do me a favour?
items.why: The fixed expression is 帮我一个忙, with 一个 inside the word. 一件, 一本 and 一张 are not used with 忙.

items.s: 姐姐去年从大学毕业以后，就跟朋友一起开了一家小店。
items.s_py: jiě jiě qù nián cóng dà xué bì yè yǐ hòu jiù gēn péng yǒu yì qǐ kāi le yī jiā xiǎo diàn
items.zh: 姐姐去年从大学毕业以后，就跟朋友一起开了一家小店。
items.py: jiě jiě qù nián cóng dà xué bì yè yǐ hòu jiù gēn péng yǒu yì qǐ kāi le yī jiā xiǎo diàn
items.en: After my older sister graduated from university last year, she opened a small shop with a friend.
items.why: 从大学毕业 is fine: the school sits before the verb with 从, which is exactly where a place belongs. Nothing follows 毕业 here, so the sentence is correct.

items.q: 大家都___她鼓掌，因为她唱得太好了。
items.zh: 大家都给她鼓掌，因为她唱得太好了。
items.py: dà jiā dōu gěi tā gǔ zhǎng yīn wèi tā chàng de tài hǎo le
items.en: Everyone applauded her because she sang so well.
items.why: 鼓掌 is verb + object (clap palms), so the person applauded goes in front with 给. 被 would reverse the roles and 把 needs an object after the verb, which 鼓掌 cannot supply.

items.q: 爸爸工作十年，从来没请___假。
items.zh: 爸爸工作十年，从来没请过假。
items.py: bà bà gōng zuò shí nián cóng lái méi qǐng guo jià
items.en: Dad has worked for ten years and has never taken a day off.
items.why: Never-experienced with 从来没 needs 过, and it sits right after 请: 请过假. 了 cannot follow 没, and 着 or 完 do not express experience.

items.q: 你太累了，先___，晚上再去买东西吧。
items.zh: 你太累了，先休息休息，晚上再去买东西吧。
items.py: nǐ tài lèi le xiān xiū xī xiū xī wǎn shàng zài qù mǎi dōng xī ba
items.en: You are too tired. Have a little rest first and go shopping in the evening.
items.why: 休息 is an ordinary two-syllable verb, so it doubles whole: 休息休息. The other forms break the word; this is the contrast with 散步.

items.zh: 我哥哥大学毕业了。
items.py: wǒ gē gē dà xué bì yè le
items.en: My older brother has graduated from university.
items.why: The school is placed before 毕业, never after it (毕业大学). Sentence-final 了 stays after the whole word.

items.q: 我妹妹唱歌___得很好。
items.zh: 我妹妹唱歌唱得很好。
items.py: wǒ mèi mèi chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo
items.en: My younger sister sings very well.
items.why: 得 must sit right after a verb, so 唱歌 is followed by a repeated 唱: 唱歌唱得很好. Leaving it out would put 得 after the noun 歌.

items.s: 妈妈睡觉了一个下午。
items.s_py: mā mā shuì jiào le yí gè xià wǔ
items.zh: 妈妈睡了一个下午觉。
items.py: mā mā shuì le yí gè xià wǔ jiào
items.en: Mum slept all afternoon.
items.why: 了 and the duration belong between 睡 and 觉. Attaching them after the whole word 睡觉 is wrong.

items.src_py: wǒ jiàn dào le gū gū
items.task: Say you met up with her, using 见面.
items.zh: 我跟姑姑见面了。
items.py: wǒ gēn gū gū jiàn miàn le
items.en: I met up with my aunt.
items.why: Replace 见到 + object with 见面, which has no object slot, so the aunt moves in front as 跟姑姑.

items.s: 我姐姐下个月要结婚小王。
items.s_py: wǒ jiě jiě xià gè yuè yào jié hūn xiǎo wáng
items.zh: 我姐姐下个月要跟小王结婚。
items.py: wǒ jiě jiě xià gè yuè yào gēn xiǎo wáng jié hūn
items.en: My older sister is marrying Xiao Wang next month.
items.why: 结婚 does not take an object, so 小王 cannot follow it. Chinese says you marry "with" someone: 跟小王结婚.

items.s: 我昨天睡觉得很晚。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì jiào de hěn wǎn
items.zh: 我昨天睡觉睡得很晚。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì jiào shuì de hěn wǎn
items.en: I went to bed very late yesterday.
items.why: 睡觉 needs the verb 睡 repeated before 得: 睡觉睡得很晚. 睡觉得很晚 puts 得 after 觉.

items.zh: 周末我去给奶奶帮忙。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ qù gěi nǎi nǎi bāng máng
items.en: I'm going to help Grandma out this weekend.
items.why: With 帮忙 the helped person is introduced before the verb by 给, since 帮忙奶奶 cannot take an object after it.

items.q: 我爸妈结婚___三十年了，从来没吵过架。
items.zh: 我爸妈结婚三十年了，从来没吵过架。
items.py: wǒ bà mā jié hūn sān shí nián le cóng lái méi chǎo guo jià
items.en: My parents have been married for thirty years and have never quarrelled.
items.why: 结婚 is a point-in-time event, so the time since it goes after the whole word with nothing inside: 结婚三十年了. 结了三十年婚 and 结婚了三十年 are not said.

items.q: 我明天___医生见面。
items.zh: 我明天跟医生见面。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān gēn yī shēng jiàn miàn
items.en: I'm meeting the doctor tomorrow.
items.why: 见面 already holds its own object (面), so the other person goes before it with 跟 ('with'). 给 means 'for' and 对 means 'toward'; neither means 'meet with'.

items.q: 他感冒了，下周不能___上海出差了。
items.zh: 他感冒了，下周不能去上海出差了。
items.py: tā gǎn mào le xià zhōu bù néng qù shàng hǎi chū chāi le
items.en: He has a cold and can't go to Shanghai on business next week.
items.why: 出差 cannot be followed by the place, so the destination comes before it as 去上海出差. 从 would mean 'from Shanghai', and 把 and 给 do not introduce a destination.

items.q: 我昨天说错话了，今天应该___她道歉。
items.zh: 我昨天说错话了，今天应该向她道歉。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān shuō cuò huà le jīn tiān yīng gāi xiàng tā dào qiàn
items.en: I said the wrong thing yesterday, so today I should apologise to her.
items.why: 道歉 has no slot for the person after it; the person you apologise to comes before the verb with 向. 让她道歉 would mean making her apologise, and 把 and 被 do not fit.

items.q: 医生进来以后，先___每位病人握了手。
items.zh: 医生进来以后，先跟每位病人握了手。
items.py: yī shēng jìn lái yǐ hòu xiān gēn měi wèi bìng rén wò le shǒu
items.en: After coming in, the doctor first shook hands with each patient.
items.why: 握手 cannot take the partner after it, so the partner goes before the verb with 跟 ('with'), and 了 sits inside the word. 给 means 'for' and 对 means 'toward', not 'with'.

items.q: 下雨天，我喜欢在家___朋友聊天。
items.zh: 下雨天，我喜欢在家跟朋友聊天。
items.py: xià yǔ tiān wǒ xǐ huan zài jiā gēn péng you liáo tiān
items.en: On rainy days I like to chat with friends at home.
items.why: 聊天 is verb + object, so 'with a friend' must come before it as 跟朋友. 对朋友聊天 would mean chatting at them, and 把 and 被 cannot be used here.

items.q: 小王还在生我___气吗？
items.zh: 小王还在生我的气吗？
items.py: xiǎo wáng hái zài shēng wǒ de qì ma
items.en: Is Xiao Wang still angry with me?
items.why: The person you are angry with sits inside 生气 as 我的: 生我的气. 得, 地 and 着 cannot link a pronoun to the noun 气.

items.q: 妈妈还在生___气，因为我忘了带伞。
items.zh: 妈妈还在生我的气，因为我忘了带伞。
items.py: mā ma hái zài shēng wǒ de qì yīn wèi wǒ wàng le dài sǎn
items.en: Mum is still angry with me because I forgot to take an umbrella.
items.why: 生气 leaves no room for a person after it, so 我 goes inside as 我的 (生我的气). 生气我气 repeats 气, and 的我 and 我得 are not possible.

items.q: 你能不能___我的忙？我手疼，拿不动箱子。
items.zh: 你能不能帮我的忙？我手疼，拿不动箱子。
items.py: nǐ néng bu néng bāng wǒ de máng wǒ shǒu téng ná bu dòng xiāng zi
items.en: Could you give me a hand? My hand hurts and I can't carry the box.
items.why: The person goes inside 帮忙 as 帮 + 我的 + 忙. 帮忙我的忙 or 帮助我的忙 would use the word twice, and 帮着我的忙 is not the pattern.

items.q: 医生今天特别忙，几个护士主动___他帮了很多忙。
items.zh: 医生今天特别忙，几个护士主动给他帮了很多忙。
items.py: yī shēng jīn tiān tè bié máng jǐ gè hù shi zhǔ dòng gěi tā bāng le hěn duō máng
items.en: The doctor was especially busy today, so several nurses volunteered to help him a lot.
items.why: 帮忙 takes no person after it, so the one helped goes before the verb with 给 ('for'). 对 means 'toward', and 把 and 被 build different sentence types.

items.q: 你为什么___我的气？
items.zh: 你为什么生我的气？
items.py: nǐ wèi shén me shēng wǒ de qì
items.en: Why are you angry with me?
items.why: 我的气 is already the object half of the word, so only 生 may come before it. 生气我的气 would use 气 twice.

items.q: 夏天太热了，我从来没在中午散___步。
items.zh: 夏天太热了，我从来没在中午散过步。
items.py: xià tiān tài rè le wǒ cóng lái méi zài zhōng wǔ sàn guo bù
items.en: It's so hot in summer that I've never gone for a walk at noon.
items.why: 从来没 asks for 过, which attaches to 散 and sits before 步: 散过步. 了 and 着 do not fit 从来没, and 得 needs a description after it.

items.q: 他昨晚一直说___话，我没睡好。
items.zh: 他昨晚一直说着话，我没睡好。
items.py: tā zuó wǎn yī zhí shuō zhe huà wǒ méi shuì hǎo
items.en: He kept talking last night and I didn't sleep well.
items.why: 一直 means the talking kept going, so 着 goes after 说: 说着话. 了 and 过 mark a finished act or an experience, and 完 would mean he stopped.

items.q: 明天下班后，我洗___澡就去找你。
items.zh: 明天下班后，我洗了澡就去找你。
items.py: míng tiān xià bān hòu wǒ xǐ le zǎo jiù qù zhǎo nǐ
items.en: Tomorrow after work I'll take a shower and then come and find you.
items.why: The first step is completed before the next clause, so 了 goes after 洗 and before 澡. 着 and 得 cannot mark a completed step, and 吗 is a question particle.

items.q: 他生病的时候从来没请___假，真厉害。
items.zh: 他生病的时候从来没请过假，真厉害。
items.py: tā shēng bìng de shí hou cóng lái méi qǐng guo jià zhēn lì hai
items.en: He never took leave even when he was ill, which is really impressive.
items.why: 没 + 过 says 'has never', and 过 sits after 请, before 假. 没请了假 cannot be said, and 着 and 完 do not express experience.

items.q: 夏天放___假，我们就去海边游泳。
items.zh: 夏天放了假，我们就去海边游泳。
items.py: xià tiān fàng le jià wǒ men jiù qù hǎi biān yóu yǒng
items.en: When the summer holiday starts, we'll go swimming at the seaside.
items.why: 了 after 放 marks the holiday as begun before the next clause follows. 放着假 would describe being on holiday, 放过假 an experience, and 得 needs a description.

items.q: 夜里太吵，我只睡___四个小时觉。
items.zh: 夜里太吵，我只睡了四个小时觉。
items.py: yè lǐ tài chǎo wǒ zhǐ shuì le sì gè xiǎo shí jiào
items.en: It was noisy at night and I only slept four hours.
items.why: 了 follows the verb 睡 and the duration 四个小时 comes before 觉: 睡了四个小时觉. 着, 得 and 的 do not mark a finished stretch of sleep.

items.q: 下雪天，我们在家聊___一个下午的天。
items.zh: 下雪天，我们在家聊了一个下午的天。
items.py: xià xuě tiān wǒ men zài jiā liáo le yī gè xià wǔ de tiān
items.en: On the snowy day we chatted at home for a whole afternoon.
items.why: A finished activity with a duration: 了 on 聊, then 一个下午的 before 天. 着 would make it ongoing, and 得 and 吗 cannot sit inside the word like this.

items.q: 他们___，孩子都上小学了。
items.zh: 他们结婚十年了，孩子都上小学了。
items.py: tā men jié hūn shí nián le hái zi dōu shàng xiǎo xué le
items.en: They've been married for ten years; their child is already in primary school.
items.why: 结婚 is a point event, so the time since goes after the whole word, then 了: 结婚十年了. 结了十年婚 treats it as an activity that lasts, which it is not.

items.q: 他们___，现在都过得很好。
items.zh: 他们离婚三年了，现在都过得很好。
items.py: tā men lí hūn sān nián le xiàn zài dōu guò de hěn hǎo
items.en: They've been divorced for three years and both are doing fine now.
items.why: 离婚 happens at one moment, so 'for three years' follows the whole word plus 了: 离婚三年了. Splitting the word (离了三年婚) is for lasting actions like 睡觉.

items.q: 他感冒了，请___三天假。
items.zh: 他感冒了，请了三天假。
items.py: tā gǎn mào le qǐng le sān tiān jià
items.en: He has a cold and took three days off.
items.why: 了 goes right after 请 and the length 三天 sits before 假: 请了三天假. 着 and 得 do not mark a completed period of leave, and 吗 cannot appear inside a statement.

items.q: 今天天气热，他游泳游___一个小时。
items.zh: 今天天气热，他游泳游了一个小时。
items.py: jīn tiān tiān qì rè tā yóu yǒng yóu le yī gè xiǎo shí
items.en: It's hot today, and he swam for an hour.
items.why: With the verb repeated, 了 follows the second 游 and the duration comes after it: 游泳游了一个小时. 着 and 得 do not mark a finished hour, and 吗 is a question particle.

items.q: 天气太热了，我想先洗___澡。
items.zh: 天气太热了，我想先洗个澡。
items.py: tiān qì tài rè le wǒ xiǎng xiān xǐ gè zǎo
items.en: It's too hot, I'd like to take a shower first.
items.why: 个 goes between 洗 and 澡 and makes the shower sound casual: 洗个澡. 次 would need a number to count showers, and 本 and 些 do not suit 澡.

items.q: 我们只见过两___面，还不太熟。
items.zh: 我们只见过两次面，还不太熟。
items.py: wǒ men zhǐ jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn hái bù tài shú
items.en: We've only met twice and aren't very close yet.
items.why: The number of meetings is counted with 次 inside the word: 见过两次面. 两个面 does not count occasions, and 些 and 本 are not measure words for it.

items.q: 你能___我一个忙吗？我的手受伤了。
items.zh: 你能帮我一个忙吗？我的手受伤了。
items.py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ yī gè máng ma wǒ de shǒu shòu shāng le
items.en: Can you do me a favour? My hand is hurt.
items.why: The pattern is plain 帮 + person + 一个忙. 帮忙 or 帮助 before 我一个忙 would use the word twice, and 帮着 is not used for asking a favour.

items.q: 他___，不想再结了。
items.zh: 他结过两次婚，不想再结了。
items.py: tā jié guo liǎng cì hūn bù xiǎng zài jié le
items.en: He has been married twice and doesn't want to marry again.
items.why: 过 and the count 两次 both go inside the word: 结 + 过 + 两次 + 婚. The other forms put 过 or 两次 around the whole word or break 结婚 in the wrong place.

items.q: 天气预报说明天有大雨，公司明天要开___会，讨论大家怎么来上班。
items.zh: 天气预报说明天有大雨，公司明天要开个会，讨论大家怎么来上班。
items.py: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān yǒu dà yǔ gōng sī míng tiān yào kāi gè huì tǎo lùn dà jiā zěn me lái shàng bān
items.en: The forecast says heavy rain tomorrow, so the company will hold a meeting to discuss how everyone gets to work.
items.why: 开个会 is the casual 'hold a meeting', with 个 inside the word. 次 needs a number before it, and 些 and 本 are not measure words for 会.

items.q: 春天来了，我们出去___吧。
items.zh: 春天来了，我们出去散散步吧。
items.py: chūn tiān lái le wǒ men chū qù sàn sàn bù ba
items.en: Spring is here, let's go out for a little walk.
items.why: Only the verb half doubles: 散散步. The other options double or shift the object 步 or the wrong part of the word.

items.q: 下雨天没事做，来我家___吧。
items.zh: 下雨天没事做，来我家聊聊天吧。
items.py: xià yǔ tiān méi shì zuò lái wǒ jiā liáo liáo tiān ba
items.en: Nothing to do on a rainy day, so come over to my place for a chat.
items.why: 'A bit of a chat' doubles only the verb 聊: 聊聊天. The other forms repeat or move 天, which is the object and cannot double.

items.q: 昨天雪很大，我们在家聊___聊天，喝了热茶。
items.zh: 昨天雪很大，我们在家聊了聊天，喝了热茶。
items.py: zuó tiān xuě hěn dà wǒ men zài jiā liáo le liáo tiān hē le rè chá
items.en: It snowed heavily yesterday; we chatted at home and drank hot tea.
items.why: A finished 'little chat' puts 了 between the doubled verb: 聊了聊天. 着 and 过 do not fit this single finished event, and 得 needs a description.

items.q: 冬天外面太冷，你就在家___，不用出去了。
items.zh: 冬天外面太冷，你就在家唱唱歌，不用出去了。
items.py: dōng tiān wài miàn tài lěng nǐ jiù zài jiā chàng chàng gē bù yòng chū qù le
items.en: It's too cold outside; just sing a little at home and don't go out.
items.why: Doubling for 'a little' applies only to the verb 唱: 唱唱歌. 歌 is the object and never doubles, so the other forms are not Chinese.

items.q: 他说话___很慢。
items.zh: 他说话说得很慢。
items.py: tā shuō huà shuō de hěn màn
items.en: He speaks very slowly.
items.why: 得 must follow a verb, so 说 is repeated after 话: 说话说得很慢. In the other options 得, 了 and 的 would attach straight to the noun 话.

items.q: 冬天我睡觉___很早，晚上九点就睡了。
items.zh: 冬天我睡觉睡得很早，晚上九点就睡了。
items.py: dōng tiān wǒ shuì jiào shuì de hěn zǎo wǎn shang jiǔ diǎn jiù shuì le
items.en: In winter I go to bed very early, at nine in the evening.
items.why: 得 has to touch a verb, so 睡 is repeated: 睡觉睡得很早. 睡觉得 attaches 得 to the noun 觉, and 睡的 and 睡了 do not form a description.

items.q: 她跳舞跳___非常好，不像生过病的人。
items.zh: 她跳舞跳得非常好，不像生过病的人。
items.py: tā tiào wǔ tiào de fēi cháng hǎo bù xiàng shēng guo bìng de rén
items.en: She dances extremely well, not like someone who has been ill.
items.why: After the repeated verb 跳, the description is introduced by 得: 跳舞跳得非常好. 的 and 地 have other jobs, and 了 would only say the dancing finished.

items.q: 路上有雪，所以她今天___不太快。
items.zh: 路上有雪，所以她今天跑步跑得不太快。
items.py: lù shang yǒu xuě suǒ yǐ tā jīn tiān pǎo bù pǎo de bù tài kuài
items.en: There's snow on the road, so she isn't running very fast today.
items.why: The verb repeats after the object so that 得 touches a verb: 跑步跑得不太快. 跑步得 and 跑步的 leave 得/的 on the noun, and 跑得步 splits the word.

items.q: 他的歌___特别好，连医生都夸他。
items.zh: 他的歌唱得特别好，连医生都夸他。
items.py: tā de gē chàng de tè bié hǎo lián yī shēng dōu kuā tā
items.en: He sings especially well; even the doctor praised him.
items.why: With 歌 fronted as the topic, the verb appears once and 得 follows it: 歌唱得特别好. 唱歌得 repeats the object, and 着 and 了 do not link a description.

items.q: 你生___气？我又没说错话。
items.zh: 你生什么气？我又没说错话。
items.py: nǐ shēng shén me qì wǒ yòu méi shuō cuò huà
items.en: What are you angry about? I didn't say anything wrong.
items.why: 什么 goes inside the word between 生 and 气: 生什么气. 为什么 would give 'why' in the wrong slot, and 生谁气 and 什么的 are not used.

items.q: 昨晚太热了，我一直睡不___觉。
items.zh: 昨晚太热了，我一直睡不着觉。
items.py: zuó wǎn tài rè le wǒ yī zhí shuì bu zháo jiào
items.en: It was so hot last night that I couldn't fall asleep.
items.why: The potential form 睡不着 sits on the verb half, before 觉: 睡不着觉. 过, 完 and 起 do not make 'can't fall asleep' (睡不起 would be 'cannot afford to sleep').

items.q: 昨天雨很大，我上___课就回家了。
items.zh: 昨天雨很大，我上完课就回家了。
items.py: zuó tiān yǔ hěn dà wǒ shàng wán kè jiù huí jiā le
items.en: It rained hard yesterday, and I went home as soon as class was over.
items.why: The result word 完 goes after the verb 上, before 课: 上完课就... 过 would mean 'have attended', and 着 and 得 do not give a result.

items.q: 我感冒了，已经三天没睡___觉了。
items.zh: 我感冒了，已经三天没睡好觉了。
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào le yǐ jīng sān tiān méi shuì hǎo jiào le
items.en: I have a cold and haven't slept properly for three days.
items.why: 好 is the result word and goes after 睡 before 觉: 没睡好觉. 完 would mean not finished sleeping, and 得 and 给 do not fit.

items.q: 外面下大雨，你___饭再走吧。
items.zh: 外面下大雨，你吃完饭再走吧。
items.py: wài miàn xià dà yǔ nǐ chī wán fàn zài zǒu ba
items.en: It's pouring outside; finish your meal before you leave.
items.why: The result word attaches to the verb: 吃完饭, built like 看完书. 吃着饭 means 'while eating', and 吃得饭 and a bare 的 are not Chinese.

items.zh: 我不想跟朋友见面。
items.py: wǒ bù xiǎng gēn péng you jiàn miàn
items.en: I don't want to meet up with my friends.
items.why: The friend comes before the verb with 跟; 见面 cannot be followed by 朋友 because 面 already fills the object slot.

items.zh: 我从来没在冬天游过泳。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi zài dōng tiān yóu guo yǒng
items.en: I have never gone swimming in winter.
items.why: 过 attaches to 游 and 泳 follows it: 游过泳. Putting 过 after the whole word (游泳过) is the tempting wrong order.

items.zh: 我今天睡了一下午觉。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān shuì le yī xià wǔ jiào
items.en: I slept all afternoon today.
items.why: The duration sits between 睡了 and 觉. 睡觉了一下午 puts 了 and the time after the unsplit word, which is wrong.

items.zh: 冬天他喜欢洗个热水澡。
items.py: dōng tiān tā xǐ huan xǐ gè rè shuǐ zǎo
items.en: In winter he likes to take a hot bath.
items.why: 个 goes between the verb 洗 and the bath 热水澡 to make it casual; it cannot follow the object.

items.zh: 因为感冒他唱歌唱得不太好。
items.py: yīn wèi gǎn mào tā chàng gē chàng de bù tài hǎo
items.en: Because he has a cold, he isn't singing very well.
items.why: Verb + object + repeated verb + 得 + description, with the negation in the description (不太好), not before 唱.

items.zh: 吃完饭我们去散散步。
items.py: chī wán fàn wǒ men qù sàn sàn bù
items.en: After dinner we'll go for a little walk.
items.why: Only the first half doubles: 散散 then 步. 散步散步 treats the word like 休息, but 步 is an object.

items.zh: 我吃完饭就去医院。
items.py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù yī yuàn
items.en: I'll go to the hospital as soon as I've eaten.
items.why: The result word 完 goes right after 吃, before 饭: 吃完饭. 吃饭完 is wrong.

items.zh: 医生帮了我的大忙。
items.py: yī shēng bāng le wǒ de dà máng
items.en: The doctor was a great help to me.
items.why: The person goes inside 帮忙 as 我的: 帮了我的大忙. 帮忙我 cannot be built from these tiles, since the person must sit between the halves.

items.zh: 爸爸生我的气了。
items.py: bà ba shēng wǒ de qì le
items.en: Dad got angry with me.
items.why: The person inside 生气 is 我的: 生我的气, and 了 closes the sentence. 生气我 is wrong.

items.zh: 他们结婚已经十年了。
items.py: tā men jié hūn yǐ jīng shí nián le
items.en: They've already been married for ten years.
items.why: 结婚 is a point event, so the time since follows the whole word and 了 ends the sentence. 结了十年婚 would be wrong.

items.zh: 孩子们在雪地里唱着歌。
items.py: hái zi men zài xuě dì lǐ chàng zhe gē
items.en: The children are singing in the snow.
items.why: 着 attaches to the verb 唱, before 歌: 唱着歌. 唱歌着 puts it after the whole word.

items.zh: 医生明天要开个会。
items.py: yī shēng míng tiān yào kāi gè huì
items.en: The doctor is going to hold a meeting tomorrow.
items.why: 个 sits between 开 and 会 and makes the meeting casual: 开个会. 开会个 is not possible.

items.zh: 爸爸今年已经出过三次差。
items.py: bà ba jīn nián yǐ jīng chū guo sān cì chāi
items.en: Dad has already been on three business trips this year.
items.why: 过 and the count 三次 go inside 出差: 出 + 过 + 三次 + 差. 出差过三次 is the tempting wrong order.

items.zh: 他每天游半个小时的泳。
items.py: tā měi tiān yóu bàn gè xiǎo shí de yǒng
items.en: He swims for half an hour every day.
items.why: The duration plus 的 goes between 游 and 泳. After the whole word (游泳半个小时) it needs the verb repeated.

items.zh: 他应该向奶奶道歉。
items.py: tā yīng gāi xiàng nǎi nai dào qiàn
items.en: He should apologise to his grandmother.
items.why: 道歉 takes no person after it, so 向奶奶 comes before the verb. 道歉奶奶 is the English-style error.

items.zh: 我哥哥今年夏天大学毕业。
items.py: wǒ gē ge jīn nián xià tiān dà xué bì yè
items.en: My older brother graduates from university this summer.
items.why: The school goes before 毕业, never after it: 大学毕业, not 毕业大学. 毕业 has no slot for another object.

items.zh: 他昨晚没睡好觉。
items.py: tā zuó wǎn méi shuì hǎo jiào
items.en: He didn't sleep well last night.
items.why: The result word 好 attaches to 睡, before 觉: 没睡好觉. 睡觉好 cannot take the result.

items.src_py: nǐ qù xǐ zǎo
items.task: Make it a gentle suggestion: 'go have a wash' with 吧.
items.zh: 你去洗洗澡吧。
items.py: nǐ qù xǐ xǐ zǎo ba
items.en: Go and have a wash.
items.why: 'A bit of' doubles only the verb half: 洗洗澡. 洗澡洗澡 is wrong.

items.src_py: tā shuì jiào shuì le shí gè xiǎo shí
items.task: Put the duration inside the word instead of repeating the verb.
items.zh: 他睡了十个小时觉。
items.py: tā shuì le shí gè xiǎo shí jiào
items.en: He slept for ten hours.
items.why: 了 and the duration go after 睡 and before 觉. 睡觉了十个小时 is wrong.

items.src_py: wǒ xiǎng xǐ zǎo
items.task: Make it casual with 个.
items.zh: 我想洗个澡。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng xǐ gè zǎo
items.en: I'd like to take a shower.
items.why: 个 goes between 洗 and 澡: 洗个澡. 洗澡个 is not possible.

items.src: 我们下了课，然后去跑步。
items.src_py: wǒ men xià le kè rán hòu qù pǎo bù
items.task: Join into one sentence with 完 and 就.
items.zh: 下完课我们就去跑步。
items.py: xià wán kè wǒ men jiù qù pǎo bù
items.en: As soon as class is over, we'll go running.
items.why: 完 attaches to 下 before 课: 下完课. 下课完 is wrong.

items.src_py: tā men liǎng nián qián jié hūn
items.task: Say they have been married for two years.
items.zh: 他们结婚两年了。
items.py: tā men jié hūn liǎng nián le
items.en: They have been married for two years.
items.why: 结婚 is a point event, so the time goes after the whole word, then 了. 结了两年婚 is wrong.

items.src_py: tā zuó wǎn shuì jiào shuì de hěn hǎo
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 他昨晚睡觉睡得不好。
items.py: tā zuó wǎn shuì jiào shuì de bù hǎo
items.en: He didn't sleep well last night.
items.why: Negation goes into the description (睡得不好), not before 睡.

items.src_py: zuó tiān xià wǔ wǒ men liáo tiān
items.task: Say 'we had a little chat' (finished), with 了.
items.zh: 昨天下午我们聊了聊天。
items.py: zuó tiān xià wǔ wǒ men liáo le liáo tiān
items.en: We had a little chat yesterday afternoon.
items.why: A finished 'bit of' puts 了 between the doubled verb: 聊了聊天. 聊聊天了 is wrong.

items.s: 他想见面爷爷。
items.s_py: tā xiǎng jiàn miàn yé ye
items.zh: 他想跟爷爷见面。
items.py: tā xiǎng gēn yé ye jiàn miàn
items.en: He wants to meet his grandfather.
items.why: 见面 cannot be followed by the person; 面 already fills the object slot. The person goes before: 跟爷爷见面.

items.s: 我哥哥结婚了一个医生。
items.s_py: wǒ gē ge jié hūn le yī gè yī shēng
items.zh: 我哥哥跟一个医生结婚了。
items.py: wǒ gē ge gēn yī gè yī shēng jié hūn le
items.en: My older brother married a doctor.
items.why: English 'marry someone' has an object, but 结婚 does not: the partner comes before as 跟一个医生结婚.

items.s: 弟弟打破了杯子，妈妈生气他了。
items.s_py: dì di dǎ pò le bēi zi mā ma shēng qì tā le
items.zh: 弟弟打破了杯子，妈妈生他的气了。
items.py: dì di dǎ pò le bēi zi mā ma shēng tā de qì le
items.en: Little brother broke a cup and Mum got angry with him.
items.why: The person you are angry with goes inside 生气 as 他的: 生他的气. 生气他 puts it after the word.

items.s: 谢谢你帮忙我。
items.s_py: xiè xie nǐ bāng máng wǒ
items.zh: 谢谢你帮我的忙。
items.py: xiè xie nǐ bāng wǒ de máng
items.en: Thank you for helping me.
items.why: 帮忙 cannot take 我 after it. The person goes inside as 帮我的忙, or use plain 帮我.

items.s: 我们以前没过见面。
items.s_py: wǒ men yǐ qián méi guo jiàn miàn
items.zh: 我们以前没见过面。
items.py: wǒ men yǐ qián méi jiàn guo miàn
items.en: We haven't met before.
items.why: 过 attaches to the verb half 见, right before 面: 没见过面. Putting 过 before 见 is wrong, like 没过吃饭. (没见面过 is heard casually, so it is not used as the wrong sentence.)

items.s: 昨晚我睡觉了八个小时。
items.s_py: zuó wǎn wǒ shuì jiào le bā gè xiǎo shí
items.zh: 昨晚我睡了八个小时觉。
items.py: zuó wǎn wǒ shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí jiào
items.en: I slept for eight hours last night.
items.why: 了 and the duration go between the halves: 睡了八个小时觉. They cannot follow the whole word 睡觉.

items.s: 我毕了两年业。
items.s_py: wǒ bì le liǎng nián yè
items.zh: 我毕业两年了。
items.py: wǒ bì yè liǎng nián le
items.en: It's been two years since I graduated.
items.why: 毕业 happens at one moment, so time since goes after the whole word with 了: 毕业两年了. The word is not split.

items.s: 天气热，我想洗澡一个。
items.s_py: tiān qì rè wǒ xiǎng xǐ zǎo yī gè
items.zh: 天气热，我想洗个澡。
items.py: tiān qì rè wǒ xiǎng xǐ gè zǎo
items.en: It's hot; I'd like a quick shower.
items.why: 个 goes between 洗 and 澡, not after the whole word. 洗澡一个 is wrong.

items.s: 晚饭后，爷爷喜欢出去散散步。
items.s_py: wǎn fàn hòu yé ye xǐ huan chū qù sàn sàn bù
items.zh: 晚饭后，爷爷喜欢出去散散步。
items.py: wǎn fàn hòu yé ye xǐ huan chū qù sàn sàn bù
items.en: After supper Grandpa likes to go out for a little walk.
items.why: Only the verb half doubles: 散散步. 步 is an object, so the whole word does not double as 休息休息 does (散步散步 is heard colloquially but is not the standard form).

items.s: 弟弟跳舞得很好。
items.s_py: dì di tiào wǔ de hěn hǎo
items.zh: 弟弟跳舞跳得很好。
items.py: dì di tiào wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo
items.en: My little brother dances very well.
items.why: 得 must come right after a verb, so 跳 repeats: 跳舞跳得很好. 舞得 attaches 得 to a noun.

items.s: 她跑步得很慢，因为脚疼。
items.s_py: tā pǎo bù de hěn màn yīn wèi jiǎo téng
items.zh: 她跑步跑得很慢，因为脚疼。
items.py: tā pǎo bù pǎo de hěn màn yīn wèi jiǎo téng
items.en: She runs very slowly because her foot hurts.
items.why: 得 needs a verb before it, so 跑 repeats after 步: 跑步跑得很慢. 跑步得 leaves 得 on the noun.

items.s: 天气这么好，你生气什么呢？
items.s_py: tiān qì zhè me hǎo nǐ shēng qì shén me ne
items.zh: 天气这么好，你生什么气呢？
items.py: tiān qì zhè me hǎo nǐ shēng shén me qì ne
items.en: The weather's so nice; what are you angry about?
items.why: 什么 goes inside the word: 生什么气. 生气什么 puts it after the whole word.

items.s: 窗外下着大雨，我睡觉不着。
items.s_py: chuāng wài xià zhe dà yǔ wǒ shuì jiào bù zháo
items.zh: 窗外下着大雨，我睡不着觉。
items.py: chuāng wài xià zhe dà yǔ wǒ shuì bu zháo jiào
items.en: Heavy rain is falling outside the window and I can't get to sleep.
items.why: The potential form 不着 goes on the verb half: 睡不着觉. 睡觉不着 is wrong.

items.s: 他毕业了大学。
items.s_py: tā bì yè le dà xué
items.zh: 他大学毕业了。
items.py: tā dà xué bì yè le
items.en: He has graduated from university.
items.why: 毕业 takes no object after it. The school goes before the verb: 大学毕业.

items.s: 爸爸下周出差北京。
items.s_py: bà ba xià zhōu chū chāi běi jīng
items.zh: 爸爸下周去北京出差。
items.py: bà ba xià zhōu qù běi jīng chū chāi
items.en: Dad is going to Beijing on business next week.
items.why: 出差 cannot be followed by the place, which must come before as 去北京出差.

items.s: 他们说话着，老师就进来了。
items.s_py: tā men shuō huà zhe lǎo shī jiù jìn lái le
items.zh: 他们说着话，老师就进来了。
items.py: tā men shuō zhe huà lǎo shī jiù jìn lái le
items.en: They were talking when the teacher walked in.
items.why: 着 attaches to the verb half 说, not to the whole word: 说着话.

items.s: 因为我感冒了还去游泳，妈妈生气我了。
items.s_py: yīn wèi wǒ gǎn mào le hái qù yóu yǒng mā ma shēng qì wǒ le
items.zh: 因为我感冒了还去游泳，妈妈生我的气了。
items.py: yīn wèi wǒ gǎn mào le hái qù yóu yǒng mā ma shēng wǒ de qì le
items.en: Mum got angry with me because I went swimming while I had a cold.
items.why: 生气 takes no person after it. The person goes inside as 我的: 生我的气.

items.s: 你别担心他，他只是感冒了。
items.s_py: nǐ bié dān xīn tā tā zhǐ shì gǎn mào le
items.zh: 你别担心他，他只是感冒了。
items.py: nǐ bié dān xīn tā tā zhǐ shì gǎn mào le
items.en: Don't worry about him; he just has a cold.
items.why: 担心 is the exception: it is a normal verb that takes an object, so 担心他 is correct, unlike 见面他.

items.s: 我们放假了，可以去海边游泳了。
items.s_py: wǒ men fàng jià le kě yǐ qù hǎi biān yóu yǒng le
items.zh: 我们放假了，可以去海边游泳了。
items.py: wǒ men fàng jià le kě yǐ qù hǎi biān yóu yǒng le
items.en: We're on holiday, so we can go swimming at the seaside now.
items.why: Sentence-final 了 after the whole word (放假了) is correct; 了 only needs to go inside when the sentence continues after the verb or a number follows.

items.s: 下雨了，你能帮我一个忙吗？
items.s_py: xià yǔ le nǐ néng bāng wǒ yī gè máng ma
items.zh: 下雨了，你能帮我一个忙吗？
items.py: xià yǔ le nǐ néng bāng wǒ yī gè máng ma
items.en: It's raining; can you do me a favour?
items.why: Plain 帮 takes the person, then 一个忙 follows. This is correct; only 帮忙我 would be wrong.

items.s: 我们放了三天假，天天下雨。
items.s_py: wǒ men fàng le sān tiān jià tiān tiān xià yǔ
items.zh: 我们放了三天假，天天下雨。
items.py: wǒ men fàng le sān tiān jià tiān tiān xià yǔ
items.en: We had three days of holiday, and it rained every day.
items.why: 放假 can take a duration inside when the holiday itself lasted three days: 放了三天假. This is correct, unlike 结了十年婚.

items.s: 夏天她每天跑步跑四十分钟。
items.s_py: xià tiān tā měi tiān pǎo bù pǎo sì shí fēn zhōng
items.zh: 夏天她每天跑步跑四十分钟。
items.py: xià tiān tā měi tiān pǎo bù pǎo sì shí fēn zhōng
items.en: In summer she runs for forty minutes every day.
items.why: Repeating the verb with a duration is a correct way to give length: 跑步跑四十分钟, with no 了 needed for a habit.

items.s: 天气好的时候，我们喜欢在院子里跳跳舞。
items.s_py: tiān qì hǎo de shí hou wǒ men xǐ huan zài yuàn zi lǐ tiào tiào wǔ
items.zh: 天气好的时候，我们喜欢在院子里跳跳舞。
items.py: tiān qì hǎo de shí hou wǒ men xǐ huan zài yuàn zi lǐ tiào tiào wǔ
items.en: When the weather is nice, we like to dance a little in the yard.
items.why: Only the verb half doubles, so 跳跳舞 is right; the temptation is to think it must be 跳舞跳舞.

items.s: 她的舞跳得非常好，连医生都说她很健康。
items.s_py: tā de wǔ tiào de fēi cháng hǎo lián yī shēng dōu shuō tā hěn jiàn kāng
items.zh: 她的舞跳得非常好，连医生都说她很健康。
items.py: tā de wǔ tiào de fēi cháng hǎo lián yī shēng dōu shuō tā hěn jiàn kāng
items.en: She dances extremely well; even the doctor says she's very healthy.
items.why: Object-first is a valid way to avoid repeating the verb: 舞跳得非常好. 得 directly follows the verb 跳.

items.s: 他洗完澡就觉得舒服多了。
items.s_py: tā xǐ wán zǎo jiù jué de shū fu duō le
items.zh: 他洗完澡就觉得舒服多了。
items.py: tā xǐ wán zǎo jiù jué de shū fu duō le
items.en: He felt much better as soon as he'd had a shower.
items.why: The result word 完 goes after 洗, before 澡: 洗完澡. Correct, built like 吃完饭.

items.s: 他们以前吵过架，现在是好朋友。
items.s_py: tā men yǐ qián chǎo guo jià xiàn zài shì hǎo péng you
items.zh: 他们以前吵过架，现在是好朋友。
items.py: tā men yǐ qián chǎo guo jià xiàn zài shì hǎo péng you
items.en: They used to quarrel, but now they're good friends.
items.why: 过 attaches to the verb half 吵, before 架: 吵过架. It looks odd to English speakers but is exactly the standard pattern.

items.s: 她今天头疼，睡了一上午觉。
items.s_py: tā jīn tiān tóu téng shuì le yī shàng wǔ jiào
items.zh: 她今天头疼，睡了一上午觉。
items.py: tā jīn tiān tóu téng shuì le yī shàng wǔ jiào
items.en: Her head hurt today and she slept the whole morning.
items.why: The duration (一上午) sits between 睡了 and 觉. This is the correct form; 睡觉了一上午 would be wrong.

items.s: 夏天晚上，大家都喜欢和邻居聊天。
items.s_py: xià tiān wǎn shang dà jiā dōu xǐ huan hé lín jū liáo tiān
items.zh: 夏天晚上，大家都喜欢和邻居聊天。
items.py: xià tiān wǎn shang dà jiā dōu xǐ huan hé lín jū liáo tiān
items.en: On summer evenings everyone likes chatting with the neighbours.
items.why: The partner comes before 聊天 with 和, exactly as it should. It is correct, not a misplaced object.

items.s: 天气一冷，我洗了澡就上床睡觉了。
items.s_py: tiān qì yī lěng wǒ xǐ le zǎo jiù shàng chuáng shuì jiào le
items.zh: 天气一冷，我洗了澡就上床睡觉了。
items.py: tiān qì yī lěng wǒ xǐ le zǎo jiù shàng chuáng shuì jiào le
items.en: Once the weather turns cold, I take a shower and go straight to bed.
items.why: Verb 了 goes inside (洗了澡) because the sentence continues with 就. The final 了 after 睡觉 is a separate sentence-final 了, so both are correct.
